"""SQLite store (D-016) with sqlite-vec loaded (D-018). Tables per D-021."""

import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

import sqlite_vec

from bmw_req.config import get_settings

NOW = "(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'))"

# Demo table set (D-021). JSON columns hold lists/objects; *_json columns are TEXT.
SCHEMA = f"""
-- Reference layer (portfolio) ------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brand (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, brand_group TEXT, positioning TEXT,
    core_values_json TEXT, guardrails_json TEXT, source_ids_json TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS platform (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_brand_group TEXT, powertrains_json TEXT, introduced TEXT,
    phase_out TEXT, successor_platform_id TEXT REFERENCES platform(id), source_ids_json TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vehicle_model (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, brand_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES brand(id), line TEXT, body TEXT,
    segment TEXT, platform_id TEXT REFERENCES platform(id), generation TEXT, sop TEXT,
    eop_planned TEXT, powertrains_json TEXT, is_bmw_group INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    market_variants_json TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS market (
    code TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, countries_json TEXT NOT NULL,  -- ["*"] = catch-all
    climate TEXT, usage_patterns TEXT, cultural_expectations TEXT, infrastructure TEXT,
    powertrain_mix TEXT, profile_source_ids_json TEXT, profile_valid_from TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plant (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, city TEXT, country TEXT, platforms_json TEXT,
    powertrains_json TEXT, nk_ready_from TEXT, capacity_note TEXT, source_ids_json TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS production (
    vehicle_model_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vehicle_model(id), plant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES plant(id),
    market_variant TEXT, markets_served_json TEXT, since TEXT, until TEXT, source_ids_json TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sales (
    vehicle_model_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vehicle_model(id), market_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES market(code),
    year INTEGER NOT NULL, units INTEGER, is_forecast INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    source_item_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES source_item(id)
);

-- Evidence layer ---------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ingest_batch (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, ts TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT {NOW},
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,           -- feedback_wave | study | sales | option_list | competitor_event | web_refresh | reference
    description TEXT, file TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_item (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,           -- feedback | study | sales | option_list | web | reference
    ref TEXT NOT NULL,            -- provenance: e.g. 'G60_feedback_hackathon.xlsx#Feedback_Explorer:G60-0001'
    external_id TEXT,             -- e.g. verbatim ID G60-0001
    trust_tier TEXT,              -- T1..T3
    vehicle_model_id TEXT REFERENCES vehicle_model(id), market_code TEXT REFERENCES market(code),
    country TEXT, platform_id TEXT REFERENCES platform(id),
    url TEXT, published_at TEXT, retrieved_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT {NOW},
    text TEXT, quote TEXT, meta_json TEXT,
    ingest_batch_id INTEGER REFERENCES ingest_batch(id),
    UNIQUE (kind, ref)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_source_scope ON source_item(vehicle_model_id, market_code);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS finding (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, type TEXT, title TEXT NOT NULL, summary TEXT,
    scope_level TEXT,             -- derivative | platform | market | portfolio
    vehicle_model_id TEXT REFERENCES vehicle_model(id), market_code TEXT REFERENCES market(code),
    platform_id TEXT REFERENCES platform(id),
    metrics_json TEXT, created_by TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT {NOW}
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS finding_source (
    finding_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES finding(id), source_item_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES source_item(id),
    quote TEXT, relation TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'supports',   -- supports | contradicts
    PRIMARY KEY (finding_id, source_item_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS verbatim_extraction (   -- one row per verbatim × extractor version (D-022)
    source_item_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES source_item(id), extractor_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    in_scope INTEGER NOT NULL, out_of_scope_reason TEXT, llm_usage_id INTEGER REFERENCES llm_usage(id),
    recheck_llm_usage_id INTEGER REFERENCES llm_usage(id),   -- second-pass check of an out-of-scope verdict (D-023)
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT {NOW},
    PRIMARY KEY (source_item_id, extractor_version)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS signal (                -- AI-extracted customer signal; input to findings (D-022)
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, source_item_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES source_item(id),
    extractor_version TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL, topic TEXT, feedback_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    severity TEXT, need_statement TEXT, quote TEXT,
    quote_verified INTEGER NOT NULL,   -- quote is a contiguous span of the verbatim (whitespace/case normalized)
    llm_usage_id INTEGER REFERENCES llm_usage(id),   -- call (and so model) that produced it (D-023)
    FOREIGN KEY (source_item_id, extractor_version) REFERENCES verbatim_extraction(source_item_id, extractor_version)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_signal_source ON signal(source_item_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS finding_signal (       -- cluster membership: which signals make up a finding (D-025)
    finding_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES finding(id), signal_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES signal(id),
    PRIMARY KEY (finding_id, signal_id)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_finding_signal_signal ON finding_signal(signal_id);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS study_metric (           -- one row per study item × model × market (D-026)
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, source_item_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES source_item(id),
    vehicle_model_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vehicle_model(id), market_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES market(code),
    item TEXT NOT NULL,           -- category / question text as in the file
    scale TEXT NOT NULL,          -- mean_10 (CN/EU means) | dist_7 (US 7-point distribution)
    mean REAL, top2 REAL, bottom3 REAL, net REAL,
    z_within_column REAL,         -- standardized vs. the other items of the same model × market column
    rank_within_column INTEGER, n_items_in_column INTEGER
);

-- Decision layer ---------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS requirement (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,          -- REQ-0001
    title TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT, category TEXT, target_metric TEXT, acceptance_criteria TEXT,
    horizon TEXT,                 -- today | at_successor_launch
    kano_class TEXT, kano_drift TEXT, evidence_level TEXT,   -- E1..E4
    assumptions TEXT, uncertainties TEXT, conflicting_evidence TEXT,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'proposed', version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT {NOW}
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS requirement_target (
    requirement_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requirement(id),
    vehicle_model_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vehicle_model(id), market_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES market(code),
    realization TEXT,             -- carry_over | platform_wide | derivative_specific | market_variant | package
    score REAL, score_breakdown_json TEXT, priority TEXT, rationale TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (requirement_id, vehicle_model_id, market_code)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS requirement_finding (
    requirement_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requirement(id), finding_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES finding(id),
    relation TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'supports',
    PRIMARY KEY (requirement_id, finding_id)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fit_check (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, requirement_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requirement(id),
    vehicle_model_id TEXT REFERENCES vehicle_model(id), market_code TEXT REFERENCES market(code),
    check_type TEXT NOT NULL,     -- brand | segment | market | feasibility
    result TEXT NOT NULL,         -- pass | warn | fail
    rationale TEXT, evidence_source_ids_json TEXT, checked_by TEXT NOT NULL, checked_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT {NOW}
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_event (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, ts TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT {NOW},
    actor_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (actor_type IN ('ai', 'human', 'system')), actor_id TEXT,
    action TEXT NOT NULL, entity_type TEXT NOT NULL, entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    field TEXT, old_value TEXT, new_value TEXT, rationale TEXT, model TEXT, prompt_ref TEXT
);
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS audit_event_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON audit_event
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'audit_event is append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS audit_event_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON audit_event
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'audit_event is append-only'); END;

-- Continuity layer (D-013) -----------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS weights_version (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, weights_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT {NOW}, rationale TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS prioritization_run (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, ts TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT {NOW},
    trigger TEXT NOT NULL,        -- new_evidence | weight_change | pm_request | scheduled
    ingest_batch_id INTEGER REFERENCES ingest_batch(id), weights_version_id INTEGER REFERENCES weights_version(id),
    model TEXT, initiated_by TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS score_snapshot (
    run_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES prioritization_run(id), requirement_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requirement(id),
    vehicle_model_id TEXT NOT NULL, market_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    score REAL, breakdown_json TEXT, rank INTEGER, priority TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (run_id, requirement_id, vehicle_model_id, market_code)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS change_proposal (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, run_id INTEGER REFERENCES prioritization_run(id),
    requirement_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requirement(id), vehicle_model_id TEXT, market_code TEXT,
    field TEXT NOT NULL, old_value TEXT, proposed_value TEXT, reason TEXT, evidence_delta_json TEXT,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open',   -- open | accepted | rejected
    decided_by TEXT, decided_at TEXT, decision_rationale TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_state (               -- e.g. current simulated wave (D-027)
    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT {NOW}
);

-- LLM bookkeeping (D-014, D-010) ----------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS llm_usage (
    id                 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT {NOW},
    settled_at         TEXT,
    job                TEXT NOT NULL,
    demo               INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    kind               TEXT NOT NULL,            -- responses | embeddings
    model              TEXT NOT NULL,
    service_tier       TEXT,
    status             TEXT NOT NULL,            -- reserved | completed | failed
    reserved_usd       REAL NOT NULL,
    cost_usd           REAL,
    input_tokens       INTEGER,
    cached_tokens      INTEGER,
    cache_write_tokens INTEGER,
    output_tokens      INTEGER,
    reasoning_tokens   INTEGER,
    search_calls       INTEGER,
    response_id        TEXT,
    error              TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS llm_cache (
    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,         -- sha256 of model + request
    job TEXT, model TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT {NOW},
    output_text TEXT, llm_usage_id INTEGER REFERENCES llm_usage(id)
);

-- Vectors (D-018): rowid = source_item.id -------------------------------------
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_embedding USING vec0(embedding float[1536]);
-- rowid = signal.id (D-025): clustering into findings + semantic retrieval for PM challenges
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS signal_embedding USING vec0(embedding float[1536]);
"""


def connect(path: Path | str | None = None) -> sqlite3.Connection:
    """Open the app DB (default `data/app.db`), load sqlite-vec and ensure the schema.

    Autocommit mode: callers open transactions explicitly (`BEGIN IMMEDIATE`).
    """
    if path is None:
        path = get_settings().db_path
    if str(path) != ":memory:":
        Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    conn = sqlite3.connect(path, isolation_level=None, check_same_thread=False)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.enable_load_extension(True)
    sqlite_vec.load(conn)
    conn.enable_load_extension(False)
    conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
    conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout=10000")
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
    conn.executescript(SCHEMA)
    _migrate(conn)
    return conn


# Columns added after a table was first created: (table, column, definition). CREATE IF NOT EXISTS
# doesn't add them to an existing DB.
MIGRATIONS = [
    ("signal", "llm_usage_id", "INTEGER REFERENCES llm_usage(id)"),
    ("verbatim_extraction", "recheck_llm_usage_id", "INTEGER REFERENCES llm_usage(id)"),
    ("signal", "support_question", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0"),   # Q-020, D-024
    # Simulated ingest waves (Q-012, D-027): the wave in which an item becomes visible to the pipeline.
    ("source_item", "wave", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1"),
    ("finding", "source_kind", "TEXT"),            # verbatim | study | web | reference
    ("finding", "polarity", "TEXT"),               # pain | want | like | context
    ("finding", "category", "TEXT"),
    ("finding", "first_wave", "INTEGER"),
    ("requirement", "effort", "TEXT"),             # S | M | L rough effort (prioritization only, no cost math)
    ("requirement", "must_not_lose", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0"),
    ("requirement", "realization_note", "TEXT"),
    ("requirement", "created_by", "TEXT"),
    ("requirement", "first_run_id", "INTEGER"),
    ("requirement", "derivation_json", "TEXT"),     # raw AI draft incl. horizon_reason, cited IDs
    ("requirement_target", "evidence_level", "TEXT"),
    ("requirement_target", "proposed_priority", "TEXT"),   # AI proposal; `priority` is the PM-confirmed one
    ("requirement_target", "run_id", "INTEGER"),
    ("change_proposal", "kind", "TEXT"),            # priority | status | content | new_requirement | link_finding
    ("audit_event", "run_id", "INTEGER"),
    # Curated reference layer: provenance + competitor details per model (competes_with, markets, strengths).
    ("vehicle_model", "source_ids_json", "TEXT"),
    ("vehicle_model", "profile_json", "TEXT"),
]


def _migrate(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
    for table, column, definition in MIGRATIONS:
        cols = {r["name"] for r in conn.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({table})")}
        if column not in cols:
            conn.execute(f"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {definition}")
            if (table, column) == ("signal", "llm_usage_id"):
                # Backfill: until D-023 every signal came from its verbatim's first-pass call.
                conn.execute(
                    """UPDATE signal SET llm_usage_id = (SELECT e.llm_usage_id FROM verbatim_extraction e
                       WHERE e.source_item_id = signal.source_item_id AND e.extractor_version = signal.extractor_version)"""
                )
"""PM-facing actions (the only write path the UI uses). Every action is a human action with a rationale and
an append-only audit event (AGENTS rules 5, 6, 8; D-003, D-013).

Status machine: proposed → approved | rejected | deferred | challenged; challenged → (AI answers) → PM decides.
Only humans change status. Brand-fit `fail` blocks approval unless the PM overrides with a rationale.
"""

import json
import sqlite3

from bmw_req.pipeline.requirements import audit

HUMAN_STATUSES = {"approved", "rejected", "deferred", "challenged", "proposed"}
EDITABLE = ["title", "description", "category", "target_metric", "acceptance_criteria", "horizon", "kano_class",
            "kano_drift", "assumptions", "uncertainties", "conflicting_evidence", "effort"]
PRIORITIES = ["Must", "Should", "Could"]


class ActionError(ValueError):
    pass


def _need(actor: str, rationale: str):
    if not actor or not actor.strip():
        raise ActionError("A named human actor is required.")
    if not rationale or len(rationale.strip()) < 5:
        raise ActionError("A rationale is required for every PM decision.")


def _tx(conn):
    conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")


def log_access(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: str, action: str, entity_type: str, entity_id: str, detail=None):
    """Access events (view/export) are part of the audit trail (brief: 'all actions, changes, access events')."""
    audit(conn, actor_type="human", actor_id=actor or "anonymous", action=action, entity_type=entity_type,
          entity_id=entity_id, new=detail)


def brand_blocked(conn, req_id: str) -> list[str]:
    """Targets whose brand check failed and have no PM override."""
    fails = [f"{r['vehicle_model_id']}×{r['market_code']}" for r in conn.execute(
        """SELECT DISTINCT vehicle_model_id, market_code FROM fit_check f WHERE requirement_id = ? AND check_type = 'brand'
           AND result = 'fail' AND id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM fit_check g WHERE g.requirement_id = f.requirement_id
           AND g.vehicle_model_id = f.vehicle_model_id AND g.market_code = f.market_code AND g.check_type = 'brand')""",
        (req_id,))]
    overridden = {r["entity_id"].split(":", 1)[1] for r in conn.execute(
        "SELECT entity_id FROM audit_event WHERE action = 'override_gate' AND entity_id LIKE ?", (f"{req_id}:%",))}
    return [t for t in fails if t not in overridden]


def set_status(conn, req_id: str, status: str, actor: str, rationale: str) -> None:
    _need(actor, rationale)
    if status not in HUMAN_STATUSES:
        raise ActionError(f"Unknown status {status}")
    req = conn.execute("SELECT status FROM requirement WHERE id = ?", (req_id,)).fetchone()
    if req is None:
        raise ActionError(f"No requirement {req_id}")
    if status == "approved":
        blocked = brand_blocked(conn, req_id)
        if blocked:
            raise ActionError(f"Brand-fit FAIL on {', '.join(blocked)} — override the gate with a rationale first.")
    _tx(conn)
    try:
        conn.execute("UPDATE requirement SET status = ? WHERE id = ?", (status, req_id))
        audit(conn, actor_type="human", actor_id=actor, action="set_status", entity_type="requirement",
              entity_id=req_id, field="status", old=req["status"], new=status, rationale=rationale)
        conn.execute("COMMIT")
    except BaseException:
        conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
        raise


def override_gate(conn, req_id: str, target: str, actor: str, rationale: str) -> None:
    _need(actor, rationale)
    _tx(conn)
    audit(conn, actor_type="human", actor_id=actor, action="override_gate", entity_type="requirement_target",
          entity_id=f"{req_id}:{target}", field="brand_fit", old="fail", new="overridden", rationale=rationale)
    conn.execute("COMMIT")


def set_priority(conn, req_id: str, vehicle: str, market: str, priority: str | None, actor: str, rationale: str) -> None:
    """PM confirms (or changes) the priority of one target."""
    _need(actor, rationale)
    if priority is not None and priority not in PRIORITIES:
        raise ActionError(f"Priority must be one of {PRIORITIES}")
    row = conn.execute("SELECT priority FROM requirement_target WHERE requirement_id = ? AND vehicle_model_id = ? AND market_code = ?",
                       (req_id, vehicle, market)).fetchone()
    _tx(conn)
    try:
        conn.execute("UPDATE requirement_target SET priority = ? WHERE requirement_id = ? AND vehicle_model_id = ? AND market_code = ?",
                     (priority, req_id, vehicle, market))
        audit(conn, actor_type="human", actor_id=actor, action="set_priority", entity_type="requirement_target",
              entity_id=f"{req_id}:{vehicle}×{market}", field="priority", old=row["priority"] if row else None,
              new=priority, rationale=rationale)
        conn.execute("COMMIT")
    except BaseException:
        conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
        raise


def edit_requirement(conn, req_id: str, changes: dict, actor: str, rationale: str, *, actor_type: str = "human",
                     model: str | None = None) -> int:
    """Edit content fields; bumps version; one audit event per changed field. Returns the new version."""
    _need(actor, rationale)
    cur = dict(conn.execute("SELECT * FROM requirement WHERE id = ?", (req_id,)).fetchone())
    diff = {k: v for k, v in changes.items() if k in EDITABLE and v != cur.get(k)}
    if not diff:
        return cur["version"]
    _tx(conn)
    try:
        sets = ", ".join(f"{k} = ?" for k in diff)
        conn.execute(f"UPDATE requirement SET {sets}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = ?", (*diff.values(), req_id))
        for k, v in diff.items():
            audit(conn, actor_type=actor_type, actor_id=actor, action="edit", entity_type="requirement", entity_id=req_id,
                  field=k, old=cur.get(k), new=v, rationale=rationale, model=model)
        if cur["status"] == "approved" and actor_type == "human":
            pass   # an approved requirement stays approved after a PM edit; the edit is in the trail
        conn.execute("COMMIT")
    except BaseException:
        conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
        raise
    return cur["version"] + 1


def set_finding_link(conn, req_id: str, finding_id: int, relation: str | None, actor: str, rationale: str) -> None:
    """PM adds/removes/changes an evidence link (relation None = remove)."""
    _need(actor, rationale)
    old = conn.execute("SELECT relation FROM requirement_finding WHERE requirement_id = ? AND finding_id = ?",
                       (req_id, finding_id)).fetchone()
    _tx(conn)
    try:
        if relation is None:
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM requirement_finding WHERE requirement_id = ? AND finding_id = ?", (req_id, finding_id))
        else:
            conn.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO requirement_finding (requirement_id, finding_id, relation) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                         (req_id, finding_id, relation))
        audit(conn, actor_type="human", actor_id=actor, action="edit_evidence", entity_type="requirement",
              entity_id=req_id, field=f"finding:{finding_id}", old=old["relation"] if old else None, new=relation,
              rationale=rationale)
        conn.execute("COMMIT")
    except BaseException:
        conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
        raise


def decide_proposal(conn, proposal_id: int, accept: bool, actor: str, rationale: str) -> None:
    """Accept or reject an AI change proposal. Accepting applies it (priority / content / link / new requirement)."""
    _need(actor, rationale)
    p = dict(conn.execute("SELECT * FROM change_proposal WHERE id = ?", (proposal_id,)).fetchone())
    if p["status"] != "open":
        raise ActionError(f"Proposal {proposal_id} is {p['status']}")
    if accept:
        kind = p["kind"] or "priority"
        if kind == "priority":
            set_priority(conn, p["requirement_id"], p["vehicle_model_id"], p["market_code"], p["proposed_value"], actor,
                         f"Accepted AI proposal #{proposal_id}: {rationale}")
        elif kind == "content":
            edit_requirement(conn, p["requirement_id"], {p["field"]: p["proposed_value"]}, actor,
                             f"Accepted AI proposal #{proposal_id}: {rationale}")
        elif kind == "link_finding":
            set_finding_link(conn, p["requirement_id"], int(p["field"].split(":")[1]), p["proposed_value"], actor,
                             f"Accepted AI proposal #{proposal_id}: {rationale}")
        elif kind == "new_requirement":
            set_status(conn, p["requirement_id"], "proposed", actor, f"Accepted new AI requirement #{proposal_id}: {rationale}")
    _tx(conn)
    try:
        conn.execute("""UPDATE change_proposal SET status = ?, decided_by = ?, decided_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
                        decision_rationale = ? WHERE id = ?""", ("accepted" if accept else "rejected", actor, rationale, proposal_id))
        audit(conn, actor_type="human", actor_id=actor, action="accept_proposal" if accept else "reject_proposal",
              entity_type="change_proposal", entity_id=str(proposal_id), field=p["field"], old=p["old_value"],
              new=p["proposed_value"], rationale=rationale)
        conn.execute("COMMIT")
    except BaseException:
        conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
        raise


def requirement_trail(conn, req_id: str) -> list[dict]:
    return [dict(r) for r in conn.execute(
        """SELECT * FROM audit_event WHERE (entity_type = 'requirement' AND entity_id = ?)
           OR (entity_type = 'requirement_target' AND entity_id LIKE ?)
           OR (entity_type = 'change_proposal' AND entity_id IN (SELECT CAST(id AS TEXT) FROM change_proposal WHERE requirement_id = ?))
           ORDER BY id""", (req_id, f"{req_id}:%", req_id))]


def export_requirements(conn) -> list[dict]:
    """Structured requirement list = the BMW deliverable (ID, description, findings+sources, score, rationale,
    evidence level, assumptions/uncertainties, status)."""
    out = []
    for r in conn.execute("SELECT * FROM requirement ORDER BY id"):
        r = dict(r)
        targets = [dict(t) for t in conn.execute("SELECT * FROM requirement_target WHERE requirement_id = ?", (r["id"],))]
        findings = []
        for f in conn.execute("""SELECT f.id, f.title, f.type, f.source_kind, f.vehicle_model_id, f.market_code, rf.relation
                                 FROM requirement_finding rf JOIN finding f ON f.id = rf.finding_id WHERE rf.requirement_id = ?""",
                              (r["id"],)):
            srcs = [dict(s) for s in conn.execute(
                """SELECT s.kind, s.ref, s.external_id, s.url, s.trust_tier, fs.quote FROM finding_source fs
                   JOIN source_item s ON s.id = fs.source_item_id WHERE fs.finding_id = ? LIMIT 25""", (f["id"],))]
            n_src = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM finding_source WHERE finding_id = ?", (f["id"],)).fetchone()[0]
            findings.append({**dict(f), "n_sources": n_src, "sources_sample": srcs})
        out.append({
            "id": r["id"], "title": r["title"], "description": r["description"], "category": r["category"],
            "target_metric": r["target_metric"], "acceptance_criteria": r["acceptance_criteria"],
            "horizon": r["horizon"], "kano_class": r["kano_class"], "kano_drift": r["kano_drift"],
            "must_not_lose": bool(r["must_not_lose"]), "effort": r["effort"],
            "evidence_level": r["evidence_level"], "status": r["status"], "version": r["version"],
            "assumptions": r["assumptions"], "uncertainties": r["uncertainties"],
            "conflicting_evidence": r["conflicting_evidence"],
            "targets": [{"target": f"{t['vehicle_model_id']}×{t['market_code']}", "realization": t["realization"],
                         "score": t["score"], "ai_proposed_priority": t["proposed_priority"],
                         "pm_priority": t["priority"], "evidence_level": t["evidence_level"],
                         "rationale": (json.loads(t["score_breakdown_json"]) or {}).get("rationale") if t["score_breakdown_json"] else None,
                         "score_breakdown": json.loads(t["score_breakdown_json"]) if t["score_breakdown_json"] else None,
                         "market_note": t["rationale"]}
                        for t in targets],
            "findings": findings,
        })
    return out

def connect(path: Path | str | None = None) -> sqlite3.Connection:
    """Open the app DB (default `data/app.db`), load sqlite-vec and ensure the schema.

    Autocommit mode: callers open transactions explicitly (`BEGIN IMMEDIATE`).
    """
    if path is None:
        path = get_settings().db_path
    if str(path) != ":memory:":
        Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    conn = sqlite3.connect(path, isolation_level=None, check_same_thread=False)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.enable_load_extension(True)
    sqlite_vec.load(conn)
    conn.enable_load_extension(False)
    conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
    conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout=10000")
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
    conn.executescript(SCHEMA)
    _migrate(conn)
    return conn

def _migrate(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
    for table, column, definition in MIGRATIONS:
        cols = {r["name"] for r in conn.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({table})")}
        if column not in cols:
            conn.execute(f"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {definition}")
            if (table, column) == ("signal", "llm_usage_id"):
                # Backfill: until D-023 every signal came from its verbatim's first-pass call.
                conn.execute(
                    """UPDATE signal SET llm_usage_id = (SELECT e.llm_usage_id FROM verbatim_extraction e
                       WHERE e.source_item_id = signal.source_item_id AND e.extractor_version = signal.extractor_version)"""
                )
"""PM-facing actions (the only write path the UI uses). Every action is a human action with a rationale and
an append-only audit event (AGENTS rules 5, 6, 8; D-003, D-013).

Status machine: proposed → approved | rejected | deferred | challenged; challenged → (AI answers) → PM decides.
Only humans change status. Brand-fit `fail` blocks approval unless the PM overrides with a rationale.
"""

import json
import sqlite3

from bmw_req.pipeline.requirements import audit

HUMAN_STATUSES = {"approved", "rejected", "deferred", "challenged", "proposed"}
EDITABLE = ["title", "description", "category", "target_metric", "acceptance_criteria", "horizon", "kano_class",
            "kano_drift", "assumptions", "uncertainties", "conflicting_evidence", "effort"]
PRIORITIES = ["Must", "Should", "Could"]


class ActionError(ValueError):
    pass


def _need(actor: str, rationale: str):
    if not actor or not actor.strip():
        raise ActionError("A named human actor is required.")
    if not rationale or len(rationale.strip()) < 5:
        raise ActionError("A rationale is required for every PM decision.")


def _tx(conn):
    conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")


def log_access(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: str, action: str, entity_type: str, entity_id: str, detail=None):
    """Access events (view/export) are part of the audit trail (brief: 'all actions, changes, access events')."""
    audit(conn, actor_type="human", actor_id=actor or "anonymous", action=action, entity_type=entity_type,
          entity_id=entity_id, new=detail)


def brand_blocked(conn, req_id: str) -> list[str]:
    """Targets whose brand check failed and have no PM override."""
    fails = [f"{r['vehicle_model_id']}×{r['market_code']}" for r in conn.execute(
        """SELECT DISTINCT vehicle_model_id, market_code FROM fit_check f WHERE requirement_id = ? AND check_type = 'brand'
           AND result = 'fail' AND id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM fit_check g WHERE g.requirement_id = f.requirement_id
           AND g.vehicle_model_id = f.vehicle_model_id AND g.market_code = f.market_code AND g.check_type = 'brand')""",
        (req_id,))]
    overridden = {r["entity_id"].split(":", 1)[1] for r in conn.execute(
        "SELECT entity_id FROM audit_event WHERE action = 'override_gate' AND entity_id LIKE ?", (f"{req_id}:%",))}
    return [t for t in fails if t not in overridden]


def set_status(conn, req_id: str, status: str, actor: str, rationale: str) -> None:
    _need(actor, rationale)
    if status not in HUMAN_STATUSES:
        raise ActionError(f"Unknown status {status}")
    req = conn.execute("SELECT status FROM requirement WHERE id = ?", (req_id,)).fetchone()
    if req is None:
        raise ActionError(f"No requirement {req_id}")
    if status == "approved":
        blocked = brand_blocked(conn, req_id)
        if blocked:
            raise ActionError(f"Brand-fit FAIL on {', '.join(blocked)} — override the gate with a rationale first.")
    _tx(conn)
    try:
        conn.execute("UPDATE requirement SET status = ? WHERE id = ?", (status, req_id))
        audit(conn, actor_type="human", actor_id=actor, action="set_status", entity_type="requirement",
              entity_id=req_id, field="status", old=req["status"], new=status, rationale=rationale)
        conn.execute("COMMIT")
    except BaseException:
        conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
        raise


def override_gate(conn, req_id: str, target: str, actor: str, rationale: str) -> None:
    _need(actor, rationale)
    _tx(conn)
    audit(conn, actor_type="human", actor_id=actor, action="override_gate", entity_type="requirement_target",
          entity_id=f"{req_id}:{target}", field="brand_fit", old="fail", new="overridden", rationale=rationale)
    conn.execute("COMMIT")


def set_priority(conn, req_id: str, vehicle: str, market: str, priority: str | None, actor: str, rationale: str) -> None:
    """PM confirms (or changes) the priority of one target."""
    _need(actor, rationale)
    if priority is not None and priority not in PRIORITIES:
        raise ActionError(f"Priority must be one of {PRIORITIES}")
    row = conn.execute("SELECT priority FROM requirement_target WHERE requirement_id = ? AND vehicle_model_id = ? AND market_code = ?",
                       (req_id, vehicle, market)).fetchone()
    _tx(conn)
    try:
        conn.execute("UPDATE requirement_target SET priority = ? WHERE requirement_id = ? AND vehicle_model_id = ? AND market_code = ?",
                     (priority, req_id, vehicle, market))
        audit(conn, actor_type="human", actor_id=actor, action="set_priority", entity_type="requirement_target",
              entity_id=f"{req_id}:{vehicle}×{market}", field="priority", old=row["priority"] if row else None,
              new=priority, rationale=rationale)
        conn.execute("COMMIT")
    except BaseException:
        conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
        raise


def edit_requirement(conn, req_id: str, changes: dict, actor: str, rationale: str, *, actor_type: str = "human",
                     model: str | None = None) -> int:
    """Edit content fields; bumps version; one audit event per changed field. Returns the new version."""
    _need(actor, rationale)
    cur = dict(conn.execute("SELECT * FROM requirement WHERE id = ?", (req_id,)).fetchone())
    diff = {k: v for k, v in changes.items() if k in EDITABLE and v != cur.get(k)}
    if not diff:
        return cur["version"]
    _tx(conn)
    try:
        sets = ", ".join(f"{k} = ?" for k in diff)
        conn.execute(f"UPDATE requirement SET {sets}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = ?", (*diff.values(), req_id))
        for k, v in diff.items():
            audit(conn, actor_type=actor_type, actor_id=actor, action="edit", entity_type="requirement", entity_id=req_id,
                  field=k, old=cur.get(k), new=v, rationale=rationale, model=model)
        if cur["status"] == "approved" and actor_type == "human":
            pass   # an approved requirement stays approved after a PM edit; the edit is in the trail
        conn.execute("COMMIT")
    except BaseException:
        conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
        raise
    return cur["version"] + 1


def set_finding_link(conn, req_id: str, finding_id: int, relation: str | None, actor: str, rationale: str) -> None:
    """PM adds/removes/changes an evidence link (relation None = remove)."""
    _need(actor, rationale)
    old = conn.execute("SELECT relation FROM requirement_finding WHERE requirement_id = ? AND finding_id = ?",
                       (req_id, finding_id)).fetchone()
    _tx(conn)
    try:
        if relation is None:
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM requirement_finding WHERE requirement_id = ? AND finding_id = ?", (req_id, finding_id))
        else:
            conn.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO requirement_finding (requirement_id, finding_id, relation) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                         (req_id, finding_id, relation))
        audit(conn, actor_type="human", actor_id=actor, action="edit_evidence", entity_type="requirement",
              entity_id=req_id, field=f"finding:{finding_id}", old=old["relation"] if old else None, new=relation,
              rationale=rationale)
        conn.execute("COMMIT")
    except BaseException:
        conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
        raise


def decide_proposal(conn, proposal_id: int, accept: bool, actor: str, rationale: str) -> None:
    """Accept or reject an AI change proposal. Accepting applies it (priority / content / link / new requirement)."""
    _need(actor, rationale)
    p = dict(conn.execute("SELECT * FROM change_proposal WHERE id = ?", (proposal_id,)).fetchone())
    if p["status"] != "open":
        raise ActionError(f"Proposal {proposal_id} is {p['status']}")
    if accept:
        kind = p["kind"] or "priority"
        if kind == "priority":
            set_priority(conn, p["requirement_id"], p["vehicle_model_id"], p["market_code"], p["proposed_value"], actor,
                         f"Accepted AI proposal #{proposal_id}: {rationale}")
        elif kind == "content":
            edit_requirement(conn, p["requirement_id"], {p["field"]: p["proposed_value"]}, actor,
                             f"Accepted AI proposal #{proposal_id}: {rationale}")
        elif kind == "link_finding":
            set_finding_link(conn, p["requirement_id"], int(p["field"].split(":")[1]), p["proposed_value"], actor,
                             f"Accepted AI proposal #{proposal_id}: {rationale}")
        elif kind == "new_requirement":
            set_status(conn, p["requirement_id"], "proposed", actor, f"Accepted new AI requirement #{proposal_id}: {rationale}")
    _tx(conn)
    try:
        conn.execute("""UPDATE change_proposal SET status = ?, decided_by = ?, decided_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),
                        decision_rationale = ? WHERE id = ?""", ("accepted" if accept else "rejected", actor, rationale, proposal_id))
        audit(conn, actor_type="human", actor_id=actor, action="accept_proposal" if accept else "reject_proposal",
              entity_type="change_proposal", entity_id=str(proposal_id), field=p["field"], old=p["old_value"],
              new=p["proposed_value"], rationale=rationale)
        conn.execute("COMMIT")
    except BaseException:
        conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
        raise


def requirement_trail(conn, req_id: str) -> list[dict]:
    return [dict(r) for r in conn.execute(
        """SELECT * FROM audit_event WHERE (entity_type = 'requirement' AND entity_id = ?)
           OR (entity_type = 'requirement_target' AND entity_id LIKE ?)
           OR (entity_type = 'change_proposal' AND entity_id IN (SELECT CAST(id AS TEXT) FROM change_proposal WHERE requirement_id = ?))
           ORDER BY id""", (req_id, f"{req_id}:%", req_id))]


def export_requirements(conn) -> list[dict]:
    """Structured requirement list = the BMW deliverable (ID, description, findings+sources, score, rationale,
    evidence level, assumptions/uncertainties, status)."""
    out = []
    for r in conn.execute("SELECT * FROM requirement ORDER BY id"):
        r = dict(r)
        targets = [dict(t) for t in conn.execute("SELECT * FROM requirement_target WHERE requirement_id = ?", (r["id"],))]
        findings = []
        for f in conn.execute("""SELECT f.id, f.title, f.type, f.source_kind, f.vehicle_model_id, f.market_code, rf.relation
                                 FROM requirement_finding rf JOIN finding f ON f.id = rf.finding_id WHERE rf.requirement_id = ?""",
                              (r["id"],)):
            srcs = [dict(s) for s in conn.execute(
                """SELECT s.kind, s.ref, s.external_id, s.url, s.trust_tier, fs.quote FROM finding_source fs
                   JOIN source_item s ON s.id = fs.source_item_id WHERE fs.finding_id = ? LIMIT 25""", (f["id"],))]
            n_src = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM finding_source WHERE finding_id = ?", (f["id"],)).fetchone()[0]
            findings.append({**dict(f), "n_sources": n_src, "sources_sample": srcs})
        out.append({
            "id": r["id"], "title": r["title"], "description": r["description"], "category": r["category"],
            "target_metric": r["target_metric"], "acceptance_criteria": r["acceptance_criteria"],
            "horizon": r["horizon"], "kano_class": r["kano_class"], "kano_drift": r["kano_drift"],
            "must_not_lose": bool(r["must_not_lose"]), "effort": r["effort"],
            "evidence_level": r["evidence_level"], "status": r["status"], "version": r["version"],
            "assumptions": r["assumptions"], "uncertainties": r["uncertainties"],
            "conflicting_evidence": r["conflicting_evidence"],
            "targets": [{"target": f"{t['vehicle_model_id']}×{t['market_code']}", "realization": t["realization"],
                         "score": t["score"], "ai_proposed_priority": t["proposed_priority"],
                         "pm_priority": t["priority"], "evidence_level": t["evidence_level"],
                         "rationale": (json.loads(t["score_breakdown_json"]) or {}).get("rationale") if t["score_breakdown_json"] else None,
                         "score_breakdown": json.loads(t["score_breakdown_json"]) if t["score_breakdown_json"] else None,
                         "market_note": t["rationale"]}
                        for t in targets],
            "findings": findings,
        })
    return out

"""Explainable per-market scoring, evidence levels, prioritization runs and change proposals
(requirement-model.md v4, D-011, D-013, D-029 — resolves Q-004).

Score of one requirement target (derivative × market) as of a wave:

    base  = Σ weight_f · value_f / Σ weight_f        over the factors that have data for this target
    score = 100 · base · confidence(evidence level) + market-fit modifier + effort modifier   (clipped 0–100)

- Factors without data for the target (e.g. no China verbatims, no study before wave 2) are left out and the
  weights renormalized — and shown as an explicit evidence gap, so a market is not punished for missing data
  but its evidence level (and so its confidence) stays honest.
- Brand fit is a gate only (fail blocks approval without PM override), not a score factor (no double counting).
- Feasibility is realization context only (Q-010 option b, D-030): shown, never scored or blocking.
- AI recomputes scores (logged, D-013); priority changes against a PM-confirmed priority become change
  proposals the PM must accept or reject.
"""

import json
import math
import sqlite3
from collections import defaultdict

from bmw_req.pipeline.requirements import audit
from bmw_req.portfolio import MIN_MARKET_VERBATIMS, all_targets

SCORING_VERSION = "score-v1"

DEFAULT_WEIGHTS = {
    "customer_voice": 30,        # severity-weighted share of this market's feedback (verbatim findings)
    "satisfaction_gap": 15,      # customer study: item weak (or, for must-not-lose, strong) vs other items
    "market_volume": 15,         # BMW sales of the derivative in this market + 2030 momentum (relative only, Q-015)
    "competitive_pressure": 15,  # cited competitor advantages / review criticism in this market
    "future_relevance": 15,      # horizon, Kano drift, cited trends/expectations
    "portfolio_leverage": 10,    # how many derivative × market targets benefit
}
FACTOR_LABELS = {
    "customer_voice": "Customer voice", "satisfaction_gap": "Satisfaction gap", "market_volume": "Market volume",
    "competitive_pressure": "Competitive pressure", "future_relevance": "Future relevance",
    "portfolio_leverage": "Portfolio leverage",
}
CONFIDENCE = {"E1": 1.0, "E2": 0.92, "E3": 0.8, "E4": 0.65}
EFFORT_MOD = {"S": 0.0, "M": -3.0, "L": -6.0}
MARKET_FIT_MOD = {"pass": 2.0, "warn": -5.0, "fail": -10.0}
PRIORITY_BANDS = [("Must", 60.0), ("Should", 45.0), ("Could", 0.0)]
TIER_W = {"T1": 1.0, "T2": 0.8, "T3": 0.5}
COMPETITIVE_TYPES = {"competitor_advantage", "review_criticism", "competitor_feature"}
TREND_TYPES = {"market_trend", "customer_expectation"}
SUPPORT_Q_WEIGHT = 0.5      # Q-020: support-call questions count half
SEVERITY_W = {"low": 1.0, "medium": 2.0, "high": 3.0}


def priority_for(score: float) -> str:
    for name, lo in PRIORITY_BANDS:
        if score >= lo:
            return name
    return "Could"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- evidence
def market_base(conn, derivative: str, market: str, wave: int) -> int:
    return conn.execute(
        """SELECT COUNT(*) FROM verbatim_extraction e JOIN source_item s ON s.id = e.source_item_id
           WHERE s.vehicle_model_id = ? AND s.market_code = ? AND s.wave <= ? AND e.in_scope = 1
             AND e.extractor_version = (SELECT MAX(extractor_version) FROM verbatim_extraction)""",
        (derivative, market, wave),
    ).fetchone()[0]


def verbatim_evidence(conn, req_id: str, derivative: str, market: str, wave: int) -> dict:
    """Distinct verbatims behind the requirement's supporting verbatim findings in this market/wave."""
    rows = conn.execute(
        """SELECT s.id sid, s.meta_json, g.severity, g.support_question FROM requirement_finding rf
           JOIN finding f ON f.id = rf.finding_id AND f.source_kind = 'verbatim'
           JOIN finding_signal fs ON fs.finding_id = f.id JOIN signal g ON g.id = fs.signal_id
           JOIN source_item s ON s.id = g.source_item_id
           WHERE rf.requirement_id = ? AND rf.relation = 'supports' AND s.vehicle_model_id = ?
             AND s.market_code = ? AND s.wave <= ?""",
        (req_id, derivative, market, wave),
    ).fetchall()
    per_verb, channels = {}, set()
    for r in rows:
        w = SEVERITY_W.get(r["severity"], 1.0) * (SUPPORT_Q_WEIGHT if r["support_question"] else 1.0)
        per_verb[r["sid"]] = max(per_verb.get(r["sid"], 0.0), w)
        channels.add(json.loads(r["meta_json"]).get("channel"))
    return {"verbatims": len(per_verb), "severity_weighted": round(sum(per_verb.values()), 2),
            "channels": sorted(c for c in channels if c)}


def linked_findings(conn, req_id: str, wave: int) -> list[dict]:
    return [dict(r) for r in conn.execute(
        """SELECT f.*, rf.relation FROM requirement_finding rf JOIN finding f ON f.id = rf.finding_id
           WHERE rf.requirement_id = ? AND COALESCE(f.first_wave, 1) <= ?""", (req_id, wave))]


def evidence_level(verb: dict, has_study: bool, n_web_strong: int, n_web_any: int) -> str:
    v, ch = verb["verbatims"], len(verb["channels"])
    if v >= 20 and ch >= 2 and (has_study or n_web_strong):
        return "E1"
    if v >= 15 or (v >= 3 and (has_study or n_web_strong)) or (has_study and n_web_strong):
        return "E2"
    if v >= 1 or has_study or n_web_any:
        return "E3"
    return "E4"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- factors
def sales_value(conn, derivative: str, market: str, wave: int) -> tuple[float | None, str]:
    rows = conn.execute(
        """SELECT s.vehicle_model_id d, s.market_code m, s.year, s.units FROM sales s
           JOIN source_item i ON i.id = s.source_item_id WHERE i.wave <= ?""", (wave,)).fetchall()
    if not rows:
        return None, "no sales data"
    latest = {}
    for r in rows:
        if r["year"] <= 2025:
            k = (r["d"], r["m"])
            if k not in latest or r["year"] > latest[k][0]:
                latest[k] = (r["year"], r["units"] or 0)
    mx = max((u for _, u in latest.values()), default=0) or 1
    year, units = latest.get((derivative, market), (None, 0))
    f2030 = next((r["units"] for r in rows if (r["d"], r["m"], r["year"]) == (derivative, market, 2030)), None)
    growth = (f2030 / units - 1) if (f2030 and units) else None
    vol = units / mx
    value = 0.75 * vol + 0.25 * (min(1.0, max(0.0, 0.5 + growth / 0.4)) if growth is not None else 0.5)
    expl = f"{units:,} units {year} (BMW file, relative only)" + (f", {growth:+.0%} to 2030" if growth is not None else "")
    return value, expl


def score_target(conn, req: dict, target: dict, wave: int, weights: dict, n_targets: int) -> dict:
    d, m = target["vehicle_model_id"], target["market_code"]
    links = linked_findings(conn, req["id"], wave)
    factors = {}

    # customer voice
    base = market_base(conn, d, m, wave)
    verb = verbatim_evidence(conn, req["id"], d, m, wave)
    if base >= MIN_MARKET_VERBATIMS:
        pct = 100 * verb["severity_weighted"] / (3 * base)
        val = min(1.0, math.log1p(pct * 4) / math.log1p(40))
        factors["customer_voice"] = (val, f"{verb['verbatims']} of {base} in-scope verbatims "
                                          f"({100 * verb['verbatims'] / base:.1f}%), channels {', '.join(verb['channels']) or '–'}")
    else:
        factors["customer_voice"] = (None, f"evidence gap: only {base} in-scope verbatims in {m} for {d}")

    # satisfaction gap (customer study)
    study = [f for f in links if f["source_kind"] == "study" and f["vehicle_model_id"] == d
             and f["market_code"] == m and f["relation"] == "supports"]
    if study:
        zs = [json.loads(f["metrics_json"] or "{}").get("z") for f in study]
        zs = [z for z in zs if z is not None]
        if zs:
            if req["must_not_lose"]:
                z = max(zs)
                val = min(1.0, max(0.0, z / 2))
            else:
                z = min(zs)
                val = min(1.0, max(0.0, -z / 2))
            factors["satisfaction_gap"] = (val, f"{len(study)} study item(s), most extreme z = {z:+.2f} ('{study[0]['title']}')")
        else:
            factors["satisfaction_gap"] = (None, "linked study items without score")
    else:
        factors["satisfaction_gap"] = (None, "no linked customer-study item for this model × market"
                                       + (" (study arrives in wave 2)" if wave < 2 else ""))

    # market volume
    val, expl = sales_value(conn, d, m, wave)
    factors["market_volume"] = (val, expl)

    # competitive pressure + trends (web findings for this market; line-level findings count too)
    def web_for(types):
        out = []
        for f in links:
            if f["source_kind"] != "web" or f["relation"] != "supports" or f["type"] not in types:
                continue
            if f["market_code"] not in (None, m):
                continue
            mt = json.loads(f["metrics_json"] or "{}")
            tiers = mt.get("tiers") or {}
            w = sum(TIER_W.get(t, 0.5) * n for t, n in tiers.items()) if isinstance(tiers, dict) else TIER_W.get(str(tiers), 0.5)
            out.append((f, w or 0.5))
        return out

    comp = web_for(COMPETITIVE_TYPES)
    cw = sum(w for _, w in comp)
    factors["competitive_pressure"] = (min(1.0, cw / 4), f"{len(comp)} competitor/review finding(s) in {m}, "
                                                         f"tier-weighted sources {cw:.1f}")
    trends = web_for(TREND_TYPES)
    fut = 0.6 if req["horizon"] == "at_successor_launch" else 0.3
    drift = (req["kano_drift"] or "").lower()
    if req["kano_class"] != "basic" and "basic" in drift:
        fut += 0.2
    fut += min(0.4, 0.1 * len(trends))
    factors["future_relevance"] = (min(1.0, fut), f"horizon {req['horizon']}, Kano {req['kano_class']}"
                                   + (" drifting to basic" if "basic" in drift and req["kano_class"] != "basic" else "")
                                   + f", {len(trends)} trend/expectation finding(s)")
    lev = min(1.0, n_targets / 4 + (0.2 if target["realization"] == "platform_wide" else 0))
    factors["portfolio_leverage"] = (lev, f"{n_targets} derivative × market target(s), realization {target['realization']}")

    avail = {k: v for k, v in factors.items() if v[0] is not None}
    wsum = sum(weights[k] for k in avail) or 1
    base_score = sum(weights[k] * v[0] for k, v in avail.items()) / wsum

    has_study = bool(factors["satisfaction_gap"][0] is not None and factors["satisfaction_gap"][0] > 0.2)
    web_any = [f for f in links if f["source_kind"] == "web" and f["market_code"] in (None, m) and f["relation"] == "supports"]
    strong = [f for f in web_any if "T1" in str(json.loads(f["metrics_json"] or "{}").get("tiers"))
              or "T2" in str(json.loads(f["metrics_json"] or "{}").get("tiers"))]
    level = evidence_level(verb, has_study, len(strong), len(web_any))
    conf = CONFIDENCE[level]

    fit = {r["check_type"]: r["result"] for r in conn.execute(
        """SELECT check_type, result FROM fit_check WHERE requirement_id = ? AND vehicle_model_id = ? AND market_code = ?
           ORDER BY id""", (req["id"], d, m))}
    mfit = MARKET_FIT_MOD.get(fit.get("market"), 0.0)
    eff = EFFORT_MOD.get(req["effort"] or "M", -3.0)
    score = max(0.0, min(100.0, 100 * base_score * conf + mfit + eff))

    breakdown = {
        "version": SCORING_VERSION, "wave": wave, "score": round(score, 1), "base": round(100 * base_score, 1),
        "evidence_level": level, "confidence": conf,
        "modifiers": {"market_fit": mfit, "effort": eff},
        "factors": {
            k: {"label": FACTOR_LABELS[k], "value": None if v[0] is None else round(v[0], 3), "weight": weights[k],
                "points": None if v[0] is None else round(100 * weights[k] * v[0] / wsum * conf, 1),
                "available": v[0] is not None, "explanation": v[1]}
            for k, v in factors.items()
        },
        "gaps": [FACTOR_LABELS[k] for k, v in factors.items() if v[0] is None],
        "gates": {"brand": fit.get("brand"), "segment": fit.get("segment"), "feasibility": fit.get("feasibility")},
        "verbatims": verb,
    }
    breakdown["rationale"] = rationale(breakdown, d, m)
    return breakdown


def rationale(b: dict, d: str, m: str) -> str:
    fs = b["factors"]
    ranked = sorted([(k, f) for k, f in fs.items() if f["available"]], key=lambda kv: -(kv[1]["points"] or 0))
    top = [f"{f['label'].lower()} ({f['explanation']})" for _, f in ranked[:2] if (f["points"] or 0) > 0]
    weak = [f["label"].lower() for _, f in ranked if (f["value"] or 0) < 0.15]
    parts = [f"{d} × {m}: score {b['score']:.0f} → proposed {priority_for(b['score'])}."]
    if top:
        parts.append("Driven by " + " and ".join(top) + ".")
    if weak:
        parts.append("Weak on " + ", ".join(weak) + ".")
    if b["gaps"]:
        parts.append("No data for " + ", ".join(g.lower() for g in b["gaps"]) + " — weights renormalized; "
                     f"evidence level {b['evidence_level']} (confidence ×{b['confidence']}).")
    else:
        parts.append(f"Evidence level {b['evidence_level']} (confidence ×{b['confidence']}).")
    if b["gates"].get("brand") == "fail":
        parts.append("Brand-fit FAIL: cannot be approved without a PM override.")
    return " ".join(parts)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- runs
def current_weights(conn) -> tuple[int, dict]:
    r = conn.execute("SELECT id, weights_json FROM weights_version ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1").fetchone()
    if r:
        return r["id"], json.loads(r["weights_json"])
    wid = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO weights_version (weights_json, created_by, rationale) VALUES (?, 'system', ?)",
        (json.dumps(DEFAULT_WEIGHTS), "Default weights (D-029)"),
    ).lastrowid
    audit(conn, actor_type="system", actor_id="scoring", action="create", entity_type="weights_version",
          entity_id=str(wid), new=DEFAULT_WEIGHTS, rationale="Default weights (D-029)")
    return wid, DEFAULT_WEIGHTS


def set_weights(conn, weights: dict, actor: str, rationale_text: str) -> int:
    old_id, old = current_weights(conn)
    wid = conn.execute("INSERT INTO weights_version (weights_json, created_by, rationale) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                       (json.dumps(weights), actor, rationale_text)).lastrowid
    audit(conn, actor_type="human", actor_id=actor, action="change_weights", entity_type="weights_version",
          entity_id=str(wid), old=old, new=weights, rationale=rationale_text)
    return wid


def last_snapshot(conn, req_id, d, m, before_run: int) -> dict | None:
    r = conn.execute(
        """SELECT * FROM score_snapshot WHERE requirement_id = ? AND vehicle_model_id = ? AND market_code = ?
           AND run_id < ? ORDER BY run_id DESC LIMIT 1""", (req_id, d, m, before_run)).fetchone()
    return dict(r) if r else None


def explain_delta(old: dict | None, new: dict) -> str:
    if not old:
        return "first scoring"
    ob = json.loads(old["breakdown_json"])
    parts = [f"score {old['score']:.1f} → {new['score']:.1f} ({new['score'] - old['score']:+.1f})"]
    deltas = []
    for k, f in new["factors"].items():
        of = ob["factors"].get(k, {})
        op, np_ = of.get("points") or 0, f.get("points") or 0
        if of.get("available") != f["available"]:
            deltas.append((abs(np_ - op), f"{f['label']}: {'now available' if f['available'] else 'no longer available'}"
                                          f" ({f['explanation']})"))
        elif abs(np_ - op) >= 0.5:
            deltas.append((abs(np_ - op), f"{f['label']} {np_ - op:+.1f} pts ({f['explanation']})"))
    if ob.get("evidence_level") != new["evidence_level"]:
        deltas.append((99, f"evidence level {ob.get('evidence_level')} → {new['evidence_level']}"))
    deltas.sort(key=lambda x: -x[0])
    return "; ".join([parts[0]] + [t for _, t in deltas[:4]])


def run_prioritization(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, wave: int, trigger: str, initiated_by: str,
                       ingest_batch_id: int | None = None, note: str | None = None) -> int:
    """Score every requirement target as of `wave`; snapshot; update targets; create change proposals."""
    conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
    try:
        wid, weights = current_weights(conn)
        run_id = conn.execute(
            """INSERT INTO prioritization_run (trigger, ingest_batch_id, weights_version_id, model, initiated_by)
               VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)""", (trigger, ingest_batch_id, wid, SCORING_VERSION, initiated_by)).lastrowid
        audit(conn, actor_type="system" if initiated_by == "system" else "human", actor_id=initiated_by,
              action="start_run", entity_type="prioritization_run", entity_id=str(run_id),
              new={"wave": wave, "trigger": trigger, "weights_version": wid}, rationale=note, run_id=run_id)
        reqs = {r["id"]: dict(r) for r in conn.execute("SELECT * FROM requirement WHERE status != 'rejected'")}
        targets = defaultdict(list)
        for t in conn.execute("SELECT * FROM requirement_target"):
            if t["requirement_id"] in reqs:
                targets[t["requirement_id"]].append(dict(t))
        results = []
        for rid, ts in targets.items():
            for t in ts:
                b = score_target(conn, reqs[rid], t, wave, weights, len(ts))
                results.append((rid, t, b))
        # rank within each derivative × market
        by_target = defaultdict(list)
        for rid, t, b in results:
            by_target[(t["vehicle_model_id"], t["market_code"])].append((rid, t, b))
        n_props = 0
        for key, items in by_target.items():
            items.sort(key=lambda x: -x[2]["score"])
            for rank, (rid, t, b) in enumerate(items, 1):
                prio = priority_for(b["score"])
                prev = last_snapshot(conn, rid, *key, run_id)
                conn.execute(
                    """INSERT INTO score_snapshot (run_id, requirement_id, vehicle_model_id, market_code, score,
                                                   breakdown_json, rank, priority) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)""",
                    (run_id, rid, *key, b["score"], json.dumps(b, ensure_ascii=False), rank, prio))
                delta = explain_delta(prev, b)
                if t["score"] is None or abs((t["score"] or 0) - b["score"]) >= 0.05:
                    audit(conn, actor_type="ai", actor_id="pipeline.scoring", action="rescore",
                          entity_type="requirement_target", entity_id=f"{rid}:{key[0]}×{key[1]}", field="score",
                          old=None if t["score"] is None else round(t["score"], 1), new=b["score"],
                          rationale=delta, model=SCORING_VERSION, run_id=run_id)
                conn.execute(
                    """UPDATE requirement_target SET score = ?, score_breakdown_json = ?, proposed_priority = ?,
                           evidence_level = ?, rationale = COALESCE(rationale, ''), run_id = ?
                       WHERE requirement_id = ? AND vehicle_model_id = ? AND market_code = ?""",
                    (b["score"], json.dumps(b, ensure_ascii=False), prio, b["evidence_level"], run_id, rid, *key))
                confirmed = t["priority"]
                if confirmed and confirmed != prio:
                    open_p = conn.execute(
                        """SELECT id FROM change_proposal WHERE requirement_id = ? AND vehicle_model_id = ? AND market_code = ?
                           AND field = 'priority' AND status = 'open'""", (rid, *key)).fetchone()
                    if open_p:
                        conn.execute("UPDATE change_proposal SET status = 'superseded' WHERE id = ?", (open_p["id"],))
                    conn.execute(
                        """INSERT INTO change_proposal (run_id, requirement_id, vehicle_model_id, market_code, field, old_value,
                               proposed_value, reason, evidence_delta_json, kind)
                           VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'priority', ?, ?, ?, ?, 'priority')""",
                        (run_id, rid, *key, confirmed, prio, delta,
                         json.dumps({"previous_run": prev["run_id"] if prev else None, "score": b["score"]})))
                    n_props += 1
        # requirement-level evidence level = best target level
        for rid, ts in targets.items():
            levels = [b["evidence_level"] for r2, _, b in results if r2 == rid]
            best = min(levels) if levels else "E4"
            if reqs[rid]["evidence_level"] != best:
                conn.execute("UPDATE requirement SET evidence_level = ? WHERE id = ?", (best, rid))
                audit(conn, actor_type="ai", actor_id="pipeline.scoring", action="update_evidence_level",
                      entity_type="requirement", entity_id=rid, field="evidence_level",
                      old=reqs[rid]["evidence_level"], new=best, rationale="best evidence level across targets",
                      model=SCORING_VERSION, run_id=run_id)
        audit(conn, actor_type="system", actor_id="pipeline.scoring", action="finish_run",
              entity_type="prioritization_run", entity_id=str(run_id),
              new={"targets": len(results), "change_proposals": n_props}, run_id=run_id)
        conn.execute("COMMIT")
    except BaseException:
        conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
        raise
    return run_id

    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--wave", type=int, default=1)
    ap.add_argument("--trigger", default="new_evidence")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    print("run", run_prioritization(connect(), wave=a.wave, trigger=a.trigger, initiated_by="system"))
"""PM challenge (brief: "review, challenge, modify"): the PM questions a requirement, its rationale or evidence;
sol answers from the stored evidence plus a semantic search over all signals (sqlite-vec), and may PROPOSE
content changes or evidence links — which become change proposals the PM accepts or rejects (AGENTS rule 5).
"""

import json
import sqlite3

import numpy as np
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from bmw_req.llm import LLM
from bmw_req.pipeline.requirements import audit
from bmw_req.service import EDITABLE, _need

PROMPT_VERSION = "challenge-v1"


class ProposedEdit(BaseModel):
    field: str = Field(description=f"one of {EDITABLE}")
    new_value: str
    reason: str


class ChallengeAnswer(BaseModel):
    verdict: str = Field(description="upheld | partially_upheld | not_upheld — is the PM's challenge right?")
    answer: str = Field(description="Plain-language answer for the PM, 3–8 sentences; cite finding IDs [F123] and verbatim IDs")
    evidence_for: list[str] = Field(description="Short bullets with IDs that support the requirement")
    evidence_against: list[str] = Field(description="Short bullets with IDs that weaken it or conflict; may be empty")
    proposed_edits: list[ProposedEdit] = Field(description="Only if the challenge shows the requirement should change")
    link_finding_ids: list[int] = Field(description="Finding IDs from the search results that should be linked as evidence")


INSTRUCTIONS = """You are the AI analyst in a BMW product-requirements tool. A product manager (PM) challenges a
proposed customer requirement. Answer honestly and specifically from the evidence given (the requirement, its
score breakdown and linked findings with quotes, plus semantically similar customer signals found by search).
- If the PM is right, say so (verdict upheld) and propose concrete edits; if partly right, partially_upheld.
- Separate evidence from assumption. Cite IDs. Never invent quotes, numbers or sources.
- Remember: markets are different customer groups; China has no verbatims (study + web only); the sales file
  is BMW-internal relative data; support-call questions are weak usability evidence.
- You never decide: edits you propose go to the PM for approval."""


def similar_signals(conn: sqlite3.Connection, llm: LLM, text: str, k: int = 25) -> list[dict]:
    vec = np.asarray(llm.embed([text], job="challenge:embed")[0], dtype=np.float32)
    rows = conn.execute(
        """SELECT e.rowid sid, e.distance, g.feedback_type, g.need_statement, g.quote, g.support_question,
                  s.external_id, s.vehicle_model_id, s.market_code,
                  (SELECT fs.finding_id FROM finding_signal fs WHERE fs.signal_id = g.id LIMIT 1) finding_id
           FROM signal_embedding e JOIN signal g ON g.id = e.rowid JOIN source_item s ON s.id = g.source_item_id
           WHERE e.embedding MATCH ? AND k = ? ORDER BY e.distance""", (vec.tobytes(), k)).fetchall()
    return [dict(r) for r in rows]


def build_context(conn: sqlite3.Connection, req_id: str) -> dict:
    req = dict(conn.execute("SELECT * FROM requirement WHERE id = ?", (req_id,)).fetchone())
    req.pop("derivation_json", None)
    targets = []
    for t in conn.execute("SELECT * FROM requirement_target WHERE requirement_id = ?", (req_id,)):
        b = json.loads(t["score_breakdown_json"]) if t["score_breakdown_json"] else {}
        targets.append({"target": f"{t['vehicle_model_id']}×{t['market_code']}", "score": t["score"],
                        "ai_priority": t["proposed_priority"], "pm_priority": t["priority"],
                        "evidence_level": t["evidence_level"], "factors": b.get("factors"), "gaps": b.get("gaps")})
    findings = []
    for f in conn.execute("""SELECT f.*, rf.relation FROM requirement_finding rf JOIN finding f ON f.id = rf.finding_id
                             WHERE rf.requirement_id = ?""", (req_id,)):
        quotes = [f"{q['external_id'] or q['ref']}: {q['quote']}" for q in conn.execute(
            """SELECT s.external_id, s.ref, fs.quote FROM finding_source fs JOIN source_item s ON s.id = fs.source_item_id
               WHERE fs.finding_id = ? LIMIT 6""", (f["id"],))]
        m = json.loads(f["metrics_json"] or "{}")
        findings.append({"id": f["id"], "relation": f["relation"], "kind": f["source_kind"], "type": f["type"],
                         "title": f["title"], "summary": f["summary"], "derivative": f["vehicle_model_id"],
                         "market": f["market_code"],
                         "markets": {k: v.get("verbatims") for k, v in m.get("by_wave", {}).get("2", {}).get("markets", {}).items()} or None,
                         "quotes": quotes})
    fits = [dict(r) for r in conn.execute(
        "SELECT vehicle_model_id, market_code, check_type, result, rationale FROM fit_check WHERE requirement_id = ?", (req_id,))]
    return {"requirement": req, "targets": targets, "linked_findings": findings, "fit_checks": fits}


def challenge(conn: sqlite3.Connection, llm: LLM, req_id: str, question: str, actor: str) -> dict:
    _need(actor, question)
    ctx = build_context(conn, req_id)
    ctx["similar_signals"] = similar_signals(conn, llm, f"{ctx['requirement']['title']}. {question}")
    conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
    old_status = ctx["requirement"]["status"]
    conn.execute("UPDATE requirement SET status = 'challenged' WHERE id = ?", (req_id,))
    audit(conn, actor_type="human", actor_id=actor, action="challenge", entity_type="requirement", entity_id=req_id,
          field="status", old=old_status, new="challenged", rationale=question)
    conn.execute("COMMIT")
    res = llm.generate(job="challenge", tier="smart", instructions=INSTRUCTIONS,
                       input=json.dumps({"pm_challenge": question, **ctx}, ensure_ascii=False, default=str),
                       schema=ChallengeAnswer, reasoning_effort="medium", max_output_tokens=12_000, demo=True)
    ans: ChallengeAnswer = res.parsed
    model = llm.model_for("smart")
    known = {r[0] for r in conn.execute("SELECT id FROM finding")}
    linked = {f["id"] for f in ctx["linked_findings"]}
    conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
    try:
        audit(conn, actor_type="ai", actor_id="pipeline.challenge", action="challenge_response", entity_type="requirement",
              entity_id=req_id, new=ans.model_dump(), rationale=ans.answer, model=model, prompt_ref=PROMPT_VERSION)
        for e in ans.proposed_edits:
            if e.field not in EDITABLE:
                continue
            cur = conn.execute(f"SELECT {e.field} FROM requirement WHERE id = ?", (req_id,)).fetchone()[0]
            conn.execute(
                """INSERT INTO change_proposal (requirement_id, field, old_value, proposed_value, reason, kind)
                   VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'content')""", (req_id, e.field, cur, e.new_value, f"PM challenge: {e.reason}"))
        for fid in ans.link_finding_ids:
            if fid in known and fid not in linked:
                conn.execute(
                    """INSERT INTO change_proposal (requirement_id, field, old_value, proposed_value, reason, kind)
                       VALUES (?, ?, NULL, 'supports', ?, 'link_finding')""",
                    (req_id, f"finding:{fid}", "Found by semantic search while answering a PM challenge"))
        conn.execute("COMMIT")
    except BaseException:
        conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
        raise
    return {"answer": ans.model_dump(), "cost": res.cost_usd, "cached": res.cached}

def build_context(conn: sqlite3.Connection, line: str, wave: int) -> tuple[dict, set[int]]:
