weights = loads(cur.iloc[0]["weights_json"], None) if not cur.empty else None
weights = {**scoring.DEFAULT_WEIGHTS, **(weights or {})}

st.subheader("Scoring weights")
if cur.empty:
    st.caption("Default weights (D-029) — no weight version stored yet.")
else:
    r = cur.iloc[0]
    st.caption(f"Current: weights version {int(r['id'])} by {r['created_by']} · {str(r['created_at'])[:16].replace('T', ' ')}"
               + (f" — “{r['rationale']}”" if r["rationale"] else ""))

left, right = st.columns([3, 2], gap="large")
with left:
    with st.form("weights"):
        new = {}
        for k, default in scoring.DEFAULT_WEIGHTS.items():
            new[k] = st.slider(scoring.FACTOR_LABELS.get(k, k), 0, 60, int(weights.get(k, default)), help=HELP.get(k))
        why = st.text_input("Rationale (required)", placeholder="e.g. Board wants more weight on competitive pressure in CN")
        wave = max(current_wave(), 1)
        submitted = st.form_submit_button(f"Save weights & re-run prioritization (wave {wave})", type="primary",
                                          disabled=not has_requirements())
        if not has_requirements():
            st.caption("Available once requirements exist.")
        if submitted:
            def apply(c, w, who, rationale, wv):
                if not rationale or len(rationale.strip()) < 5:
                    raise ActionError("A rationale is required for a weight change.")
                if sum(w.values()) <= 0:
                    raise ActionError("At least one weight must be > 0.")
                scoring.set_weights(c, w, who, rationale.strip())
                return scoring.run_prioritization(c, wave=wv, trigger="weight_change", initiated_by=who, note=rationale.strip())

            if new == weights:
                st.info("Weights unchanged — nothing to re-run.")
            else:
                act(apply, new, actor(), why, wave, success="Weights saved and prioritization re-run (no LLM cost).")
with right:
    tot = sum(new.values()) or 1
    wdf = pd.DataFrame([{"factor": scoring.FACTOR_LABELS.get(k, k), "share": v / tot,
                         "current": weights.get(k, 0) / (sum(weights.values()) or 1)} for k, v in new.items()])
    st.altair_chart(alt.Chart(wdf).mark_bar(color="#1c69d4", cornerRadiusEnd=3).encode(
        y=alt.Y("factor:N", sort=None, title=None), x=alt.X("share:Q", axis=alt.Axis(format="%"), title="share of base score"),
        tooltip=["factor", alt.Tooltip("share:Q", format=".0%"), alt.Tooltip("current:Q", format=".0%", title="saved")],
    ).properties(height=230), width="stretch")
    st.caption("Weights are relative. Factors without data for a target are left out and the rest renormalized; the "
               "evidence level then lowers confidence (E1 ×1.0 … E4 ×0.65). Brand fit is a gate, not a factor.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ runs
st.subheader("Prioritization runs")
runs = q("""SELECT r.id, r.ts, r.trigger, r.initiated_by, r.weights_version_id, r.model,
                   (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM score_snapshot s WHERE s.run_id = r.id) targets_scored,
                   (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM change_proposal p WHERE p.run_id = r.id) proposals,
                   (SELECT a.new_value FROM audit_event a WHERE a.action = 'start_run' AND a.entity_type = 'prioritization_run'
                      AND a.entity_id = CAST(r.id AS TEXT) LIMIT 1) start,
                   (SELECT a.rationale FROM audit_event a WHERE a.action = 'start_run' AND a.entity_type = 'prioritization_run'
                      AND a.entity_id = CAST(r.id AS TEXT) LIMIT 1) note
            FROM prioritization_run r ORDER BY r.id DESC""")
if runs.empty:
    empty("No prioritization runs yet.")
    st.stop()
runs["wave"] = runs["start"].map(lambda s: (loads(s, {}) or {}).get("wave"))
st.dataframe(runs.drop(columns=["start"]), hide_index=True, width="stretch", column_config={
    "id": st.column_config.NumberColumn("Run", format="%d"), "weights_version_id": "Weights v.",
    "model": "Scoring version", "targets_scored": "Targets scored", "proposals": "Change proposals",
    "note": st.column_config.TextColumn("Note / rationale", width="large")})

st.subheader("What changed between two runs")
if len(runs) < 2:
    st.caption("Needs at least two runs.")
    st.stop()
labels = {int(r.id): run_label(r.id, r.ts, r.trigger) + (f" · wave {int(r.wave)}" if pd.notna(r.wave) else "")
          for r in runs.itertuples()}
ids = list(labels)
c1, c2, c3 = st.columns([2, 2, 2])
b_id = c2.selectbox("Newer run", ids, index=0, format_func=labels.get)
a_id = c1.selectbox("Older run", [i for i in ids if i < b_id] or ids, index=0, format_func=labels.get)
snaps = q("""SELECT s.run_id, s.requirement_id, s.vehicle_model_id || ' × ' || s.market_code target, s.score, s.rank,
                    s.priority, r.title FROM score_snapshot s JOIN requirement r ON r.id = s.requirement_id
             WHERE s.run_id IN (?, ?)""", (int(a_id), int(b_id)))
A = snaps[snaps["run_id"] == a_id].drop(columns="run_id")
B = snaps[snaps["run_id"] == b_id].drop(columns="run_id")
diff = A.merge(B, on=["requirement_id", "target", "title"], how="outer", suffixes=("_old", "_new"))
diff["Δ score"] = diff["score_new"] - diff["score_old"]
diff["rank move"] = diff["rank_old"] - diff["rank_new"]
diff["change"] = diff.apply(lambda r: "new" if pd.isna(r["score_old"]) else ("dropped" if pd.isna(r["score_new"]) else (
    f"{r['priority_old']} → {r['priority_new']}" if r["priority_old"] != r["priority_new"] else "")), axis=1)
tsel = c3.multiselect("Targets", sorted(diff["target"].dropna().unique()))
if tsel:
    diff = diff[diff["target"].isin(tsel)]
moved = diff[(diff["Δ score"].abs() >= 0.5) | (diff["change"] != "") | diff["Δ score"].isna()]
m = st.columns(4)
m[0].metric("Targets compared", len(diff))
m[1].metric("Score moved ≥ 0.5", int((diff["Δ score"].abs() >= 0.5).sum()))
m[2].metric("AI priority changed", int(diff["change"].str.contains("→").sum()))
m[3].metric("New / dropped", int(diff["change"].isin(["new", "dropped"]).sum()))
wa = runs.set_index("id").loc[[a_id, b_id], "weights_version_id"].tolist()
if wa[0] != wa[1]:
    wv = q("SELECT id, weights_json FROM weights_version WHERE id IN (?, ?)", (int(wa[0] or 0), int(wa[1] or 0)))
    wmap = {int(r.id): loads(r.weights_json, {}) for r in wv.itertuples()}
    st.caption("Weights changed between the runs: " + ", ".join(
        f"{scoring.FACTOR_LABELS.get(k, k)} {wmap.get(int(wa[0] or 0), {}).get(k)} → {v}"
        for k, v in wmap.get(int(wa[1] or 0), {}).items() if wmap.get(int(wa[0] or 0), {}).get(k) != v) or "—")
if moved.empty:
    st.success("Nothing moved between these runs.")
else:
    top = moved.dropna(subset=["Δ score"]).reindex(moved["Δ score"].abs().sort_values(ascending=False).index).head(25)
    if not top.empty:
        top = top.assign(label=top["requirement_id"] + " · " + top["target"])
        st.altair_chart(alt.Chart(top).mark_bar(cornerRadiusEnd=2).encode(
            y=alt.Y("label:N", sort=None, title=None), x=alt.X("Δ score:Q", title="score change (points)"),
            color=alt.condition(alt.datum["Δ score"] > 0, alt.value("#1c69d4"), alt.value("#c0392b")),
            tooltip=["requirement_id", "title", "target", alt.Tooltip("score_old:Q", format=".1f"),
                     alt.Tooltip("score_new:Q", format=".1f"), "rank_old", "rank_new", "change"],
        ).properties(height=22 * len(top) + 30), width="stretch")
    causes = q("""SELECT entity_id, rationale FROM audit_event WHERE action = 'rescore' AND run_id = ?""", (int(b_id),))
    cmap = dict(zip(causes["entity_id"], causes["rationale"])) if not causes.empty else {}
    moved = moved.assign(cause=[cmap.get(f"{r.requirement_id}:{str(r.target).replace(' × ', '×')}", "")
                                for r in moved.itertuples()])
    st.dataframe(moved.sort_values("Δ score", key=lambda s: -s.abs())[
        ["requirement_id", "title", "target", "score_old", "score_new", "Δ score", "rank_old", "rank_new", "rank move",
         "change", "cause"]], hide_index=True, width="stretch", column_config={
        "score_old": st.column_config.NumberColumn("old", format="%.1f"),
        "score_new": st.column_config.NumberColumn("new", format="%.1f"),
        "Δ score": st.column_config.NumberColumn(format="%+.1f"),
        "rank move": st.column_config.NumberColumn(format="%+d", help="positive = moved up"),
        "cause": st.column_config.TextColumn("Cause (factor delta)", width="large")})

"""Global audit trail: every action, change and access event (append-only), filterable, CSV export."""

import datetime as dt

import streamlit as st

from ui.common import empty, log_export, page_header, q

page_header("Audit trail",
            "Complete chronological record of AI, system and human actions — content, scores, priorities, evidence, "
            "status, and access events. Append-only: the database rejects updates and deletes.")

total = int(q("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM audit_event").iat[0, 0])
if not total:
    empty("No audit events yet.")
    st.stop()

facets = q("SELECT actor_type, actor_id, action, entity_type, MIN(ts) mn, MAX(ts) mx FROM audit_event "
           "GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4")
c1, c2, c3, c4 = st.columns(4)
at = c1.multiselect("Actor type", sorted(facets["actor_type"].dropna().unique()))
ac = c2.multiselect("Actor", sorted(facets["actor_id"].dropna().unique()))
an = c3.multiselect("Action", sorted(facets["action"].dropna().unique()))
et = c4.multiselect("Entity type", sorted(facets["entity_type"].dropna().unique()))
c5, c6, c7 = st.columns([2, 3, 1])
mn = dt.date.fromisoformat(str(facets["mn"].min())[:10])
mx = dt.date.fromisoformat(str(facets["mx"].max())[:10])
rng = c5.date_input("Date range", value=(mn, mx), min_value=mn, max_value=mx)
txt = c6.text_input("Search (entity, rationale, values)", placeholder="e.g. REQ-0003 or brand")
limit = c7.selectbox("Max rows", [500, 2000, 10000], index=1)

where, params = [], []
for col, vals in (("actor_type", at), ("actor_id", ac), ("action", an), ("entity_type", et)):
    if vals:
        where.append(f"{col} IN ({','.join('?' * len(vals))})")
        params += list(vals)
if isinstance(rng, (tuple, list)) and len(rng) == 2:
    where.append("substr(ts, 1, 10) BETWEEN ? AND ?")
    params += [rng[0].isoformat(), rng[1].isoformat()]
if txt:
    where.append("(entity_id LIKE ? OR rationale LIKE ? OR old_value LIKE ? OR new_value LIKE ? OR field LIKE ?)")
    params += [f"%{txt}%"] * 5
sql = ("SELECT id, ts, actor_type, actor_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, field, old_value, new_value, rationale, "
       "model, prompt_ref, run_id FROM audit_event" + (" WHERE " + " AND ".join(where) if where else "")
       + f" ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT {int(limit)}")
df = q(sql, tuple(params))

m = st.columns(4)
m[0].metric("Matching events (shown)", f"{len(df):,}", help=f"{total:,} events in total")
m[1].metric("Human", int((df["actor_type"] == "human").sum()))
m[2].metric("AI", int((df["actor_type"] == "ai").sum()))
m[3].metric("System", int((df["actor_type"] == "system").sum()))

st.dataframe(df, hide_index=True, width="stretch", height=560, column_config={
    "id": st.column_config.NumberColumn("#", format="%d", width="small"),
    "ts": st.column_config.TextColumn("When (UTC)"),
    "old_value": st.column_config.TextColumn("Before", width="medium"),
    "new_value": st.column_config.TextColumn("After", width="medium"),
    "rationale": st.column_config.TextColumn("Rationale", width="large")})

st.download_button("Download CSV", df.to_csv(index=False).encode("utf-8"), file_name="audit_trail.csv",
                   mime="text/csv", icon=":material/download:", on_click=log_export,
                   args=("audit_trail.csv", f"{len(df)} rows; filters: {' AND '.join(where) or 'none'}"))
st.caption("Downloading is itself logged as an access event.")

"""Export: the structured requirement list (the BMW deliverable) as JSON, CSV (one row per target) and a
Markdown report. Every download is logged as an access event."""

import json

import pandas as pd
import streamlit as st

from bmw_req import service
from ui.common import _LOCK, conn, empty, log_export, page_header

page_header("Export",
            "The structured requirement list: ID, description, linked findings and sources, score and rationale per "
            "market, evidence level, assumptions and uncertainties, decision status.")


@st.cache_data(ttl=20, show_spinner="Building export …")
def build() -> list[dict]:
    with _LOCK:
        return service.export_requirements(conn())


data = build()
if not data:
    empty("No requirements to export yet.")
    st.stop()

statuses = sorted({r["status"] for r in data})
sel = st.multiselect("Include status", statuses, default=[s for s in statuses if s != "rejected"] or statuses)
data = [r for r in data if r["status"] in sel]

rows = []
for r in data:
    for t in r["targets"] or [{}]:
        rows.append({
            "id": r["id"], "title": r["title"], "category": r["category"], "status": r["status"], "version": r["version"],
            "target": t.get("target"), "realization": t.get("realization"), "score": t.get("score"),
            "ai_proposed_priority": t.get("ai_proposed_priority"), "pm_priority": t.get("pm_priority"),
            "evidence_level_target": t.get("evidence_level"), "evidence_level": r["evidence_level"],
            "horizon": r["horizon"], "kano_class": r["kano_class"], "kano_drift": r["kano_drift"],
            "must_not_lose": r["must_not_lose"], "effort": r["effort"], "description": r["description"],
            "target_metric": r["target_metric"], "acceptance_criteria": r["acceptance_criteria"],
            "prioritization_rationale": t.get("rationale"), "market_note": t.get("market_note"),
            "assumptions": r["assumptions"], "uncertainties": r["uncertainties"],
            "conflicting_evidence": r["conflicting_evidence"],
            "findings": "; ".join(f"F{f['id']} ({f['source_kind']}, {f['relation']}, {f['n_sources']} src)" for f in r["findings"]),
            "n_sources": sum(f["n_sources"] for f in r["findings"]),
        })
flat = pd.DataFrame(rows)


def markdown_report(items: list[dict]) -> str:
    out = ["# Customer requirements — successor BMW vehicles", "",
           "AI-derived, PM-reviewed. Evidence and assumptions are listed separately. Scores are per derivative × market.", ""]
    for r in items:
        out += [f"## {r['id']} · {r['title']}", "",
                f"- **Status:** {r['status']} (v{r['version']}) · **Evidence level:** {r['evidence_level'] or '–'} · "
                f"**Horizon:** {r['horizon']} · **Kano:** {r['kano_class']} ({r['kano_drift'] or 'stable'}) · "
                f"**Effort:** {r['effort'] or '–'}" + (" · **Must-not-lose**" if r["must_not_lose"] else ""),
                f"- **Category:** {r['category']}", "", r["description"] or "", "",
                f"**Target metric:** {r['target_metric'] or '–'}  ", f"**Acceptance criteria:** {r['acceptance_criteria'] or '–'}", "",
                "| Target | Realization | Score | AI priority | PM priority | Evidence |", "|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
        for t in r["targets"]:
            sc = f"{t['score']:.0f}" if t.get("score") is not None else "–"
            out.append(f"| {t['target']} | {t['realization'] or '–'} | {sc} | {t['ai_proposed_priority'] or '–'} | "
                       f"{t['pm_priority'] or 'not set'} | {t['evidence_level'] or '–'} |")
        out.append("")
        for t in r["targets"]:
            if t.get("rationale"):
                out.append(f"- *{t['target']}:* {t['rationale']}")
        out += ["", "**Evidence (linked findings)**", ""]
        for f in r["findings"]:
            out.append(f"- F{f['id']} [{f['source_kind']}, {f['relation']}] {f['title']} — {f['n_sources']} source(s)")
            for s in f["sources_sample"][:3]:
                ref = s.get("external_id") or s.get("url") or s.get("ref")
                q = (s.get("quote") or "").replace("\n", " ")
                out.append(f"  - {ref}" + (f": “{q[:200]}”" if q else ""))
        out += ["", "**Assumptions (forward-looking)**", "", r["assumptions"] or "–", "",
                "**Uncertainties**", "", r["uncertainties"] or "–", "",
                "**Conflicting evidence**", "", r["conflicting_evidence"] or "–", "", "---", ""]
    return "\n".join(out)


c = st.columns(4)
c[0].metric("Requirements", len(data))
c[1].metric("Targets", len(flat))
c[2].metric("Approved", sum(r["status"] == "approved" for r in data))
c[3].metric("PM-confirmed priorities", int(flat["pm_priority"].notna().sum()) if not flat.empty else 0)

d1, d2, d3 = st.columns(3)
d1.download_button("JSON (full, with sources)", json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, default=str).encode("utf-8"),
                   file_name="requirements.json", mime="application/json", icon=":material/data_object:",
                   on_click=log_export, args=("requirements.json", f"{len(data)} requirements"), width="stretch")
d2.download_button("CSV (one row per target)", flat.to_csv(index=False).encode("utf-8"), file_name="requirements.csv",
                   mime="text/csv", icon=":material/table:", on_click=log_export,
                   args=("requirements.csv", f"{len(flat)} rows"), width="stretch")
report = markdown_report(data)
d3.download_button("Markdown report", report.encode("utf-8"), file_name="requirements.md", mime="text/markdown",
                   icon=":material/article:", on_click=log_export, args=("requirements.md", f"{len(data)} requirements"),
                   width="stretch")
st.caption("Every download is recorded as an access event in the audit trail.")

tab1, tab2 = st.tabs(["Table preview", "Report preview"])
with tab1:
    st.dataframe(flat, hide_index=True, width="stretch", height=480,
                 column_config={"score": st.column_config.NumberColumn(format="%.0f")})
with tab2:
    st.markdown(report[:60000])
    if len(report) > 60000:
        st.caption("Preview truncated — download for the full report.")

import altair as alt
import pandas as pd
import streamlit as st

from bmw_req.llm import budget
from ui.common import empty, page_header, q, q1

page_header("Budget", "Every OpenAI call is reserved, logged and settled through the budget-guarded wrapper — "
                      "$100 total for the whole project.")

spent = q1("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd), 0) FROM llm_usage WHERE status != 'reserved'") or 0.0
committed = q1("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'reserved' THEN reserved_usd ELSE cost_usd END), 0) FROM llm_usage") or 0.0
n_calls = q1("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM llm_usage") or 0
cache_hits = q1("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM llm_cache") or 0

c = st.columns(4)
c[0].metric("Spent", f"${spent:.2f}")
c[1].metric("Committed (incl. open reservations)", f"${committed:.2f}")
c[2].metric("Warn / block non-demo / hard stop",
            f"${budget.WARN_USD:.0f} / ${budget.BLOCK_NON_DEMO_USD:.0f} / ${budget.HARD_STOP_USD:.0f}")
c[3].metric("Calls logged", f"{n_calls:,}", help=f"{cache_hits:,} cached responses available for free reuse")

bar = pd.DataFrame([{"what": "committed", "usd": committed}, {"what": "spent", "usd": spent}])
rules = pd.DataFrame([{"usd": budget.WARN_USD, "label": "warn"}, {"usd": budget.BLOCK_NON_DEMO_USD, "label": "block non-demo"},
                      {"usd": budget.HARD_STOP_USD, "label": "hard stop"}])
st.altair_chart(
    (alt.Chart(bar).mark_bar(size=22, cornerRadiusEnd=3).encode(
        y=alt.Y("what:N", title=None, sort=["spent", "committed"]),
        x=alt.X("usd:Q", scale=alt.Scale(domain=[0, 100]), title="USD of $100"),
        color=alt.Color("what:N", scale=alt.Scale(domain=["spent", "committed"], range=["#1c69d4", "#8fb8ee"]), legend=None),
        tooltip=["what", alt.Tooltip("usd:Q", format="$.2f")])
     + alt.Chart(rules).mark_rule(color="#c0392b", strokeDash=[4, 3]).encode(x="usd:Q", tooltip=["label", "usd"])
     + alt.Chart(rules).mark_text(dy=-34, fontSize=10, color="#842029").encode(x="usd:Q", text="label:N"))
    .properties(height=110), width="stretch")

usage["job_group"] = usage["job"].str.split(":").str[0]
left, right = st.columns(2, gap="large")
with left:
    st.markdown("**Spend by job**")
    by_job = usage.groupby("job", as_index=False).agg(calls=("id", "count"), usd=("cost_usd", "sum"),
                                                      reserved=("reserved_usd", "sum")).sort_values("usd", ascending=False)
    st.altair_chart(alt.Chart(by_job.head(20)).mark_bar(color="#1c69d4", cornerRadiusEnd=3).encode(
        y=alt.Y("job:N", sort=None, title=None), x=alt.X("usd:Q", title="USD"),
        tooltip=["job", "calls", alt.Tooltip("usd:Q", format="$.4f")]).properties(height=22 * min(len(by_job), 20) + 30),
        width="stretch")
with right:
    st.markdown("**Spend by model**")
    by_model = usage.groupby(["model", "kind"], as_index=False).agg(
        calls=("id", "count"), usd=("cost_usd", "sum"), input_tokens=("input_tokens", "sum"),
        cached_tokens=("cached_tokens", "sum"), output_tokens=("output_tokens", "sum"), searches=("search_calls", "sum"))
    st.dataframe(by_model, hide_index=True, width="stretch",
                 column_config={"usd": st.column_config.NumberColumn("USD", format="$%.4f")})
    st.markdown("**By status**")
    st.dataframe(usage.groupby("status", as_index=False).agg(calls=("id", "count"), usd=("cost_usd", "sum")),
                 hide_index=True, width="stretch", column_config={"usd": st.column_config.NumberColumn("USD", format="$%.4f")})

st.markdown("**Usage log**")
jobs = st.multiselect("Job group", sorted(usage["job_group"].dropna().unique()))
log = usage[usage["job_group"].isin(jobs)] if jobs else usage
st.dataframe(log.drop(columns=["job_group"]).head(500), hide_index=True, width="stretch", height=420,
             column_config={"cost_usd": st.column_config.NumberColumn("cost", format="$%.5f"),
                            "reserved_usd": st.column_config.NumberColumn("reserved", format="$%.5f")})

"""Global audit trail: every action, change and access event (append-only), filterable, CSV export."""

import datetime as dt

import streamlit as st

from ui.common import empty, log_export, page_header, q

page_header("Audit trail",
            "Complete chronological record of AI, system and human actions — content, scores, priorities, evidence, "
            "status, and access events. Append-only: the database rejects updates and deletes.")

total = int(q("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM audit_event").iat[0, 0])
if not total:
    empty("No audit events yet.")
    st.stop()

facets = q("SELECT actor_type, actor_id, action, entity_type, MIN(ts) mn, MAX(ts) mx FROM audit_event "
           "GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4")
c1, c2, c3, c4 = st.columns(4)
at = c1.multiselect("Actor type", sorted(facets["actor_type"].dropna().unique()))
ac = c2.multiselect("Actor", sorted(facets["actor_id"].dropna().unique()))
an = c3.multiselect("Action", sorted(facets["action"].dropna().unique()))
et = c4.multiselect("Entity type", sorted(facets["entity_type"].dropna().unique()))
c5, c6, c7 = st.columns([2, 3, 1])
mn = dt.date.fromisoformat(str(facets["mn"].min())[:10])
mx = dt.date.fromisoformat(str(facets["mx"].max())[:10])
rng = c5.date_input("Date range", value=(mn, mx), min_value=mn, max_value=mx)
txt = c6.text_input("Search (entity, rationale, values)", placeholder="e.g. REQ-0003 or brand")
limit = c7.selectbox("Max rows", [500, 2000, 10000], index=1)

where, params = [], []
for col, vals in (("actor_type", at), ("actor_id", ac), ("action", an), ("entity_type", et)):
    if vals:
        where.append(f"{col} IN ({','.join('?' * len(vals))})")
        params += list(vals)
if isinstance(rng, (tuple, list)) and len(rng) == 2:
    where.append("substr(ts, 1, 10) BETWEEN ? AND ?")
    params += [rng[0].isoformat(), rng[1].isoformat()]
if txt:
    where.append("(entity_id LIKE ? OR rationale LIKE ? OR old_value LIKE ? OR new_value LIKE ? OR field LIKE ?)")
    params += [f"%{txt}%"] * 5
sql = ("SELECT id, ts, actor_type, actor_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, field, old_value, new_value, rationale, "
       "model, prompt_ref, run_id FROM audit_event" + (" WHERE " + " AND ".join(where) if where else "")
       + f" ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT {int(limit)}")
df = q(sql, tuple(params))

m = st.columns(4)
m[0].metric("Matching events (shown)", f"{len(df):,}", help=f"{total:,} events in total")
m[1].metric("Human", int((df["actor_type"] == "human").sum()))
m[2].metric("AI", int((df["actor_type"] == "ai").sum()))
m[3].metric("System", int((df["actor_type"] == "system").sum()))

st.dataframe(df, hide_index=True, width="stretch", height=560, column_config={
    "id": st.column_config.NumberColumn("#", format="%d", width="small"),
    "ts": st.column_config.TextColumn("When (UTC)"),
    "old_value": st.column_config.TextColumn("Before", width="medium"),
    "new_value": st.column_config.TextColumn("After", width="medium"),
    "rationale": st.column_config.TextColumn("Rationale", width="large")})

st.download_button("Download CSV", df.to_csv(index=False).encode("utf-8"), file_name="audit_trail.csv",
                   mime="text/csv", icon=":material/download:", on_click=log_export,
                   args=("audit_trail.csv", f"{len(df)} rows; filters: {' AND '.join(where) or 'none'}"))
st.caption("Downloading is itself logged as an access event.")

c[0].metric("Spent", f"${spent:.2f}")
c[1].metric("Committed (incl. open reservations)", f"${committed:.2f}")
c[2].metric("Warn / block non-demo / hard stop",
            f"${budget.WARN_USD:.0f} / ${budget.BLOCK_NON_DEMO_USD:.0f} / ${budget.HARD_STOP_USD:.0f}")
c[3].metric("Calls logged", f"{n_calls:,}", help=f"{cache_hits:,} cached responses available for free reuse")

bar = pd.DataFrame([{"what": "committed", "usd": committed}, {"what": "spent", "usd": spent}])
rules = pd.DataFrame([{"usd": budget.WARN_USD, "label": "warn"}, {"usd": budget.BLOCK_NON_DEMO_USD, "label": "block non-demo"},
                      {"usd": budget.HARD_STOP_USD, "label": "hard stop"}])
st.altair_chart(
    (alt.Chart(bar).mark_bar(size=22, cornerRadiusEnd=3).encode(
        y=alt.Y("what:N", title=None, sort=["spent", "committed"]),
        x=alt.X("usd:Q", scale=alt.Scale(domain=[0, 100]), title="USD of $100"),
        color=alt.Color("what:N", scale=alt.Scale(domain=["spent", "committed"], range=["#1c69d4", "#8fb8ee"]), legend=None),

     + alt.Chart(rules).mark_rule(color="#c0392b", strokeDash=[4, 3]).encode(x="usd:Q", tooltip=["label", "usd"])
     + alt.Chart(rules).mark_text(dy=-34, fontSize=10, color="#842029").encode(x="usd:Q", text="label:N"))
    .properties(height=110), width="stretch")

left, right = st.columns(2, gap="large")
with left:
    st.markdown("**Spend by job**")
    by_job = usage.groupby("job", as_index=False).agg(calls=("id", "count"), usd=("cost_usd", "sum"),
                                                      reserved=("reserved_usd", "sum")).sort_values("usd", ascending=False)
    st.altair_chart(alt.Chart(by_job.head(20)).mark_bar(color="#1c69d4", cornerRadiusEnd=3).encode(
        y=alt.Y("job:N", sort=None, title=None), x=alt.X("usd:Q", title="USD"),
        tooltip=["job", "calls", alt.Tooltip("usd:Q", format="$.4f")]).properties(height=22 * min(len(by_job), 20) + 30),
        width="stretch")
with right:

    by_model = usage.groupby(["model", "kind"], as_index=False).agg(
        calls=("id", "count"), usd=("cost_usd", "sum"), input_tokens=("input_tokens", "sum"),
        cached_tokens=("cached_tokens", "sum"), output_tokens=("output_tokens", "sum"), searches=("search_calls", "sum"))
    st.dataframe(by_model, hide_index=True, width="stretch",
                 column_config={"usd": st.column_config.NumberColumn("USD", format="$%.4f")})
    st.markdown("**By status**")
    st.dataframe(usage.groupby("status", as_index=False).agg(calls=("id", "count"), usd=("cost_usd", "sum")),
                 hide_index=True, width="stretch", column_config={"usd": st.column_config.NumberColumn("USD", format="$%.4f")})

st.markdown("**Usage log**")
jobs = st.multiselect("Job group", sorted(usage["job_group"].dropna().unique()))
log = usage[usage["job_group"].isin(jobs)] if jobs else usage
st.dataframe(log.drop(columns=["job_group"]).head(500), hide_index=True, width="stretch", height=420,

    conn.execute("""INSERT INTO fit_check (requirement_id, vehicle_model_id, market_code, check_type, result, rationale, checked_by)
                    VALUES ('REQ-0001', 'G60', 'US', 'brand', 'fail', 'paywalls hardware', 'ai:test')""")
    assert service.brand_blocked(conn, "REQ-0001") == ["G60×US"]
    with pytest.raises(ActionError, match="Brand-fit FAIL"):
        service.set_status(conn, "REQ-0001", "approved", PM, "Strong evidence")
    assert status(conn) == "proposed"
    with pytest.raises(ActionError):
        service.override_gate(conn, "REQ-0001", "G60×US", PM, "")
    service.override_gate(conn, "REQ-0001", "G60×US", PM, "Feature is included, not paywalled")
    assert service.brand_blocked(conn, "REQ-0001") == []
    service.set_status(conn, "REQ-0001", "approved", PM, "Strong evidence; gate overridden")
    assert status(conn) == "approved"
    assert [e["action"] for e in events(conn) if e["actor_type"] == "human"] == ["override_gate", "set_status"]


def test_latest_brand_check_wins(conn):
    conn.execute("""INSERT INTO fit_check (requirement_id, vehicle_model_id, market_code, check_type, result, checked_by)
                    VALUES ('REQ-0001', 'G60', 'EU', 'brand', 'fail', 'ai:test')""")
    conn.execute("""INSERT INTO fit_check (requirement_id, vehicle_model_id, market_code, check_type, result, checked_by)
                    VALUES ('REQ-0001', 'G60', 'EU', 'brand', 'pass', 'ai:test')""")
    assert service.brand_blocked(conn, "REQ-0001") == []


def test_priority_change_is_audited(conn):
    service.set_priority(conn, "REQ-0001", "G60", "US", "Should", PM, "US evidence weaker than the score suggests")
    row = conn.execute("SELECT priority, proposed_priority FROM requirement_target WHERE market_code = 'US'").fetchone()
    assert (row["priority"], row["proposed_priority"]) == ("Should", "Must")   # AI proposal untouched
    ev = events(conn, "set_priority")
    assert len(ev) == 1 and ev[0]["entity_id"] == "REQ-0001:G60×US" and ev[0]["new_value"] == "Should"
    assert ev[0]["old_value"] is None
    with pytest.raises(ActionError):
        service.set_priority(conn, "REQ-0001", "G60", "US", "Critical", PM, "not a priority band")
    with pytest.raises(ActionError):
        service.set_priority(conn, "REQ-0001", "G60", "CN", "Must", PM, "no such target")
    assert len(events(conn, "set_priority")) == 1


def test_edit_bumps_version_one_event_per_field(conn):
    v = service.edit_requirement(conn, "REQ-0001", {"title": "Instant phone pairing", "effort": "S", "status": "approved"},
                                 PM, "Sharper wording")
    r = conn.execute("SELECT title, effort, version, status FROM requirement").fetchone()
    assert v == 2 and (r["title"], r["effort"], r["version"], r["status"]) == ("Instant phone pairing", "S", 2, "proposed")
    assert sorted(e["field"] for e in events(conn, "edit")) == ["effort", "title"]   # status is not editable here
    assert service.edit_requirement(conn, "REQ-0001", {"title": "Instant phone pairing"}, PM, "no-op") == 2


def test_finding_link_add_change_remove(conn):
    service.set_finding_link(conn, "REQ-0001", 2, "contradicts", PM, "EU owners praise the opposite")
    service.set_finding_link(conn, "REQ-0001", 1, None, PM, "Not about pairing")
    links = {r[0]: r[1] for r in conn.execute("SELECT finding_id, relation FROM requirement_finding")}
    assert links == {2: "contradicts"}
    ev = events(conn, "edit_evidence")
    assert [(e["field"], e["old_value"], e["new_value"]) for e in ev] == [("finding:2", None, "contradicts"),
                                                                         ("finding:1", "supports", None)]


def test_accepting_priority_proposal_applies_it(conn):
    service.set_priority(conn, "REQ-0001", "G60", "EU", "Must", PM, "Confirmed AI proposal")
    pid = conn.execute("""INSERT INTO change_proposal (requirement_id, vehicle_model_id, market_code, field, old_value,
                              proposed_value, reason, kind) VALUES ('REQ-0001', 'G60', 'EU', 'priority', 'Must', 'Could',
                              'customer voice -12 pts', 'priority')""").lastrowid
    with pytest.raises(ActionError):
        service.decide_proposal(conn, pid, True, PM, "")
    service.decide_proposal(conn, pid, True, PM, "New wave shows the issue is fixed")
    assert conn.execute("SELECT priority FROM requirement_target WHERE market_code = 'EU'").fetchone()[0] == "Could"
    p = conn.execute("SELECT status, decided_by, decision_rationale FROM change_proposal WHERE id = ?", (pid,)).fetchone()
    assert tuple(p) == ("accepted", PM, "New wave shows the issue is fixed")
    assert [e["action"] for e in events(conn) if e["actor_type"] == "human"][-2:] == ["set_priority", "accept_proposal"]
    with pytest.raises(ActionError):   # already decided
        service.decide_proposal(conn, pid, False, PM, "changed my mind")
    with pytest.raises(ActionError):
        service.decide_proposal(conn, 999, True, PM, "does not exist")


def test_accepting_content_and_link_proposals(conn):
    c1 = conn.execute("""INSERT INTO change_proposal (requirement_id, field, old_value, proposed_value, reason, kind)
                         VALUES ('REQ-0001', 'target_metric', NULL, 'Pairing < 5 s', 'PM challenge', 'content')""").lastrowid
    c2 = conn.execute("""INSERT INTO change_proposal (requirement_id, field, old_value, proposed_value, reason, kind)
                         VALUES ('REQ-0001', 'finding:2', NULL, 'supports', 'semantic search', 'link_finding')""").lastrowid
    service.decide_proposal(conn, c1, True, PM, "Measurable target")
    service.decide_proposal(conn, c2, True, PM, "Relevant evidence")
    r = conn.execute("SELECT target_metric, version FROM requirement").fetchone()
    assert (r["target_metric"], r["version"]) == ("Pairing < 5 s", 2)
    assert conn.execute("SELECT relation FROM requirement_finding WHERE finding_id = 2").fetchone()[0] == "supports"


def test_rejecting_proposal_changes_nothing(conn):
    pid = conn.execute("""INSERT INTO change_proposal (requirement_id, field, old_value, proposed_value, reason, kind)
                          VALUES ('REQ-0001', 'title', 'Seamless phone pairing', 'Other', 'x', 'content')""").lastrowid
    service.decide_proposal(conn, pid, False, PM, "Original wording is clearer")
    assert conn.execute("SELECT title, version FROM requirement").fetchone()[:] == ("Seamless phone pairing", 1)
    assert events(conn, "reject_proposal")[0]["rationale"] == "Original wording is clearer"


def test_audit_is_append_only_and_access_logged(conn):
    service.log_access(conn, PM, "view", "requirement", "REQ-0001")
    service.log_access(conn, PM, "export", "export", "requirements.json", "3 requirements")
    ev = events(conn)
    assert [(e["action"], e["actor_type"]) for e in ev] == [("view", "human"), ("export", "human")]
    with pytest.raises(sqlite3.IntegrityError):
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM audit_event")
    service.set_status(conn, "REQ-0001", "rejected", PM, "Out of segment")
    assert len(events(conn)) == 3


def test_export_and_trail(conn):
    service.set_priority(conn, "REQ-0001", "G60", "US", "Must", PM, "Confirmed")
    conn.execute("UPDATE requirement_target SET score_breakdown_json = ? WHERE market_code = 'US'",
                 (json.dumps({"rationale": "driven by customer voice"}),))
    out = service.export_requirements(conn)
    assert out[0]["id"] == "REQ-0001" and len(out[0]["targets"]) == 2 and out[0]["findings"][0]["n_sources"] == 1
    us = next(t for t in out[0]["targets"] if t["target"] == "G60×US")
    assert (us["pm_priority"], us["ai_proposed_priority"], us["rationale"]) == ("Must", "Must", "driven by customer voice")
    trail = service.requirement_trail(conn, "REQ-0001")
    assert [e["action"] for e in trail] == ["set_priority"]

entries.name: mcp__claude-in-chrome__computer
entries.description:
Use a mouse and keyboard to interact with a web browser, and take screenshots. If you don't have a valid tab ID, use tabs_context_mcp first to get available tabs.
* Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element before moving the cursor.
* If you tried clicking on a program or link but it failed to load, even after waiting, try adjusting your click location so that the tip of the cursor visually falls on the element that you want to click.
* Make sure to click any buttons, links, icons, etc with the cursor tip in the center of the element. Don't click boxes on their edges unless asked.

action.description:
The action to perform:
* `left_click`: Click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `right_click`: Click the right mouse button at the specified coordinates to open context menus.
* `double_click`: Double-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `triple_click`: Triple-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `type`: Type a string of text.
* `screenshot`: Take a screenshot of the screen.
* `wait`: Wait for a specified number of seconds.
* `scroll`: Scroll up, down, left, or right at the specified coordinates.
* `key`: Press a specific keyboard key.
* `left_click_drag`: Drag from start_coordinate to coordinate.
* `zoom`: Take a screenshot of a specific region for closer inspection.
* `scroll_to`: Scroll an element into view using its element reference ID from read_page or find tools.
* `hover`: Move the mouse cursor to the specified coordinates or element without clicking. Useful for revealing tooltips, dropdown menus, or triggering hover states.

coordinate.description: (x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates. Required for `left_click`, `right_click`, `double_click`, `triple_click`, and `scroll`. For `left_click_drag`, this is the end position.

text.description: The text to type (for `type` action) or the key(s) to press (for `key` action). For `key` action: Provide space-separated keys (e.g., "Backspace Backspace Delete"). Supports keyboard shortcuts using the platform's modifier key (use "cmd" on Mac, "ctrl" on Windows/Linux, e.g., "cmd+a" or "ctrl+a" for select all). Page zoom shortcuts (e.g. "cmd+=", "ctrl+-", "cmd+0") are not supported and will return an error - use the `zoom` action to magnify a region of the page instead.

duration.description: The number of seconds to wait. Required for `wait`. Maximum 10 seconds.

scroll_direction.description: The direction to scroll. Required for `scroll`.

scroll_amount.description: The number of scroll wheel ticks. Optional for `scroll`, defaults to 3.

region.description: (x0, y0, x1, y1): The rectangular region to capture for `zoom`. Coordinates define a rectangle from top-left (x0, y0) to bottom-right (x1, y1) in pixels from the viewport origin. Required for `zoom` action. Useful for inspecting small UI elements like icons, buttons, or text.

scale.description: For `screenshot` and `zoom` only. Scale factor in [0.1, 1] for the returned image; 1 (default) uses the full image token budget, 0.5 returns an image at half the width and height (~quarter of the tokens). Coordinates are ALWAYS in the full-resolution coordinate frame (reported with every scaled screenshot), never in the scaled image's own pixels. Requires a Claude in Chrome extension version that supports scale; older extensions return the full-size image.

repeat.description: Number of times to repeat the key sequence. Only applicable for `key` action. Must be a positive integer between 1 and 100. Default is 1. Useful for navigation tasks like pressing arrow keys multiple times.

ref.description: Element reference ID from read_page or find tools (e.g., "ref_1", "ref_2"). Required for `scroll_to` action. Can be used as alternative to `coordinate` for click actions.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys for click actions. Supports: "ctrl", "shift", "alt", "cmd" (or "meta"), "win" (or "windows"). Can be combined with "+" (e.g., "ctrl+shift", "cmd+alt"). Optional.

tabId.description: Tab ID to execute the action on. Must be a tab in the current group. Use tabs_context_mcp first if you don't have a valid tab ID.

save_to_disk.description: For screenshot/zoom actions: save the image to disk so it can be attached to a message for the user. Returns the saved path in the tool result. Only set this when you intend to share the image — screenshots you're just looking at don't need saving.

action_summary.description: A few words saying what this action does on the page and to what, for example 'Sends the drafted reply to pat@example.com' or 'Opens the Filters menu'. Set it on every left_click, right_click, double_click, triple_click, left_click_drag, key and type action. State the effect only, and accurately: no reasons, nothing about what you were asked or allowed to do, no passwords or other secrets.

entries.name: mcp__claude-in-chrome__get_page_text
entries.description: Extract raw text content from the page, prioritizing article content. Ideal for reading articles, blog posts, or other text-heavy pages. Returns plain text without HTML formatting. If you don't have a valid tab ID, use tabs_context_mcp first to get available tabs.

tabId.description: Tab ID to extract text from. Must be a tab in the current group. Use tabs_context_mcp first if you don't have a valid tab ID.

entries.name: mcp__claude-in-chrome__navigate
entries.description: Navigate to a URL, or go forward/back in browser history. tabId may be omitted for URL navigation when calling navigate STANDALONE (not inside browser_batch): tabs_context_mcp{createIfEmpty:true} is called for you and the first tab in the session's group is navigated — its result is appended to this call's output so you have the tab list and ids for subsequent calls. Inside browser_batch, navigate (and other tools that act on a page) requires an explicit tabId. Pass an explicit tabId when you need a specific tab or when the session's group has multiple tabs whose state you must preserve. tabId is required for url:"back"/"forward". A tab opened for you this way is yours to clean up, the same as one from tabs_create_mcp: close it with tabs_close_mcp once you no longer need it and before finishing your task, unless the user asked to see it or wants it kept open.

url.description: The URL to navigate to. Can be provided with or without protocol (defaults to https://). Use "forward" to go forward in history or "back" to go back in history.

tabId.description: Tab ID to navigate. Must be a tab in the current group. If omitted for URL navigation when calling navigate standalone, tabs_context_mcp{createIfEmpty:true} is called for you. Required for url:"back"/"forward" and for navigate (and other tools that act on a page) inside browser_batch.

entries.name: mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_close_mcp
entries.description: Close a tab in the MCP tab group by its ID. Use to clean up tabs you're done with. Only tabs in this session's group are closable; call tabs_context_mcp first to get valid IDs. If you close the group's last tab, Chrome auto-removes the group — the next tabs_context_mcp with createIfEmpty starts fresh.

tabId.description: The ID of the tab to close. Must be in this session's tab group. Get valid IDs from tabs_context_mcp.

entries.name: mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp
entries.description: Get context information about the current MCP tab group. Returns all tab IDs inside the group if it exists. CRITICAL: You must get the context at least once before using other browser automation tools so you know what tabs exist. Each new conversation should create its own new tab (using tabs_create_mcp) rather than reusing existing tabs, unless the user explicitly asks to use an existing tab.

createIfEmpty.description: Creates a new MCP tab group if none exists, creates a new Window with a new tab group containing an empty tab (which can be used for this conversation). If a MCP tab group already exists, this parameter has no effect.

entries.name: mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_create_mcp
entries.description: Creates a new empty tab in the MCP tab group. CRITICAL: You must get the context using tabs_context_mcp at least once before using other browser automation tools so you know what tabs exist. Tabs you create are yours to clean up: close each one with tabs_close_mcp as soon as you no longer need it, and close any that remain before finishing your task. Leave a tab open only if the user asked to see it or wants it kept open.

input.message:
The PM web app is built: all 11 pages run without exceptions against an empty copy of the real DB and a synthetic test DB, and `uv run pytest -q` passes (41 tests). I wrote no fake data into data/app.db and made no paid calls. Opening a wave and the Challenge button are wired up but have never actually been run.

**Run:** `uv run streamlit run app.py`. For a UI demo against the synthetic copy, prefix `DATA_DIR=<scratchpad>/uidata`.

**Files created**
- `app.py` (replaced): navigation in 4 sections. Sidebar has "Acting as" (default "Atahan (PM)", stored in session_state), the wave badge marked SIMULATION, and the spend metric.
- `.streamlit/config.toml`: light theme, primary #1c69d4.
- `ui/common.py`: cached connection, 20 s cached reads, a write wrapper that shows `ActionError` nicely and clears caches, colour chips, the shared target query, and one view event per session per requirement.
- `ui/overview.py`, `portfolio.py`, `backlog.py`, `requirement.py`, `inbox.py`, `conflicts.py`, `findings.py`, `weights.py`, `audit.py`, `export.py`, `budget.py`.
- `tests/test_service.py`: 11 tests on an in-memory DB covering your list (rationale required, brand FAIL blocks until override, priority change audited, accepting a proposal applies it, audit append-only) plus edits/version bump, link changes, reject-is-no-op, export and trail.

**Pages:** all 11 from the spec, Overview through Budget. Two behaviours differ from what you might expect:
- **Backlog:** with 2–3 targets selected it shows one combined table (one row per requirement, rank/score/AI/PM columns per market). Three separate tables did not fit on screen.
- **Requirement, priority form:** "Confirm priorities" records every target's shown value, so unconfirmed targets get the AI proposal confirmed in one go. In my test, changing one target wrote 3 `set_priority` events.

**Change to `service.py`:** three small fixes. An unknown proposal id now raises `ActionError` (it used to raise a TypeError), `set_priority` on a target that doesn't exist now raises instead of writing an audit row, and `override_gate` now rolls back on error. No schema changes and no new dependencies.

**What I tested**
- AppTest on every page script plus `app.py`, against an empty copy of the real DB (786 findings, 0 requirements) and the synthetic DB.
- Interaction tests through AppTest on the synthetic DB:
  - approval blocked by brand FAIL, then override, then approval succeeds;
  - priority confirm, content edit (version goes to 2), evidence-link removal;
  - weight change creates a new run;
  - inbox accept works, and reject without a rationale is refused.
- Started the server headless on port 8599 and the health check returned ok. I also checked Overview, Backlog, Portfolio, Requirement and Inbox in a browser and fixed what was wrong: graph labels, NaN values showing, cramped side-by-side tables. Server stopped, tab closed.

**Known gaps**
- The synthetic test DB builder is in my scratchpad (`make_ui_db.py`, not part of the repo); its output is `uidata/app.db`.
- The server has no file watcher, so after editing `ui/common.py` it must be restarted; page files reload on their own.
- Selecting a row in a table only pre-selects it in the "Open requirement" picker; you still click Open. This is deliberate, so going back to the page doesn't jump away again.
- The Weights page saves new weights and immediately runs a prioritization (no LLM cost). If no wave has been opened yet, it scores as of wave 1.
- Opening a wave and the Challenge call run synchronously and block the page until they finish.
- I did not edit STATE.md, DECISIONS.md or OPEN_QUESTIONS.md, so the Streamlit UI isn't recorded in the foundation docs yet.

Synthetic data: `/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-atahankilic-Documents-ehl-munich-final/bacd3b1d-4756-430b-bc24-1896d160c515/scratchpad/uidata/app.db`
